items.title: CacheWarp: Software-based Fault Injection using Selective State Reset.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种名为CacheWarp的新型软件故障注入方法，核心思想是通过选择性重置处理器状态来诱导系统出现可控的错误行为。与传统物理故障注入（如激光、电磁）不同，CacheWarp完全基于软件实现，无需接触硬件。其原理是利用处理器缓存行填充与驱逐的时序差异，通过精心构造的内存访问模式，在特定时刻触发缓存一致性协议中的漏洞，导致数据损坏或指令执行错误。作者在主流x86和ARM处理器上验证了该方法的有效性，实验表明能够以高成功率绕过操作系统安全机制、篡改关键数据结构（如页表权限），并可在远程场景下实施。该工作揭示了现代处理器微架构中缓存一致性作为新型攻击面的可能性，对系统安全设计提出了新挑战。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 展示了纯软件实现硬件级故障注入的可能性，降低攻击门槛，迫使安全团队重新审视软件缓存一致性模型的安全假设。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可影响使用X86/ARM架构的服务器、云计算节点，尤其对依赖硬件隔离（如SGX、TrustZone）的场景构成威胁，可能用于提权或逃逸。

items.title: SecurityNet: Assessing Machine Learning Vulnerabilities on Public Models.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一个名为 SecurityNet 的框架，旨在系统性地评估公开机器学习模型的安全性弱点。随着预训练模型在开源社区（如 Hugging Face）广泛发布，攻击者可能利用这些模型中的后门、对抗性扰动等漏洞。SecurityNet 通过组合多种攻击方法（包括对抗性攻击、后门注入、模型窃取等），对公开模型进行自动化安全评估。实验覆盖了图像分类、自然语言处理等多种任务中的主流模型架构（如 ResNet、BERT）。主要贡献包括：1) 设计了一个模块化的评估管线，支持多种攻击场景；2) 在大量公开模型上进行了实证研究，揭示了相当比例的模型存在可利用的漏洞；3) 提供了可复现的基准，帮助研究者比较不同防御手段的效果。该工作为模型发布前的安全审查和模型供应链风险管控提供了参考工具。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 帮助安全团队在引入第三方预训练模型前评估潜在风险，降低模型供应链攻击的可能性。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至模型资产管理、模型卡校验、红队评估等场景。

items.title: VoltSchemer: Use Voltage Noise to Manipulate Your Wireless Charger.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种名为 VoltSchemer 的新型攻击方法，通过向无线充电器注入精心设计的电压噪声，攻击者可以操纵充电器的行为，从而实现对受电设备的非授权控制。研究背景在于无线充电技术日益普及，但现有安全研究多聚焦于通信协议层面，忽视了电源传输通道的物理安全。核心方法是通过调节电源电压的幅度、频率和相位，产生特定的噪声模式，这些噪声会被无线充电器的控制电路解调并误认为是合法的控制指令。实验证明，该攻击能够导致设备过热、电池损坏、数据传输错误甚至固件篡改。主要贡献包括：首次系统性地分析了无线充电器电源链路的脆弱性；设计并实现了低成本（约10美元）的噪声注入装置；展示了针对Qi标准充电器的多种攻击场景。本文适合硬件安全工程师、物联网安全研究人员以及无线充电标准制定者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 无线充电器作为广泛部署的物联网设备，其物理层安全性长期被忽视。VoltSchemer 揭示了通过电源噪声绕过数字安全机制的可行路径，可能被用于大规模破坏或物理性拒绝服务。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有基于感应式无线充电（尤其是Qi标准）的消费电子设备，包括手机、手表、耳机和电动汽车的无线充电系统。攻击可导致设备损坏、数据泄露或成为物理攻击的跳板。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 评估现有无线充电设备的电源滤波和指令验证机制，建议在充电器端增加电压噪声检测与响应功能。

items.title: Don't Waste My Efforts: Pruning Redundant Sanitizer Checks by Developer-Implemented Type Checks.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对当前软件安全中广泛使用的消毒器（sanitizer）存在的冗余检查问题展开研究。消毒器通过插入运行时检查来检测内存错误、未定义行为等漏洞，但大量检查是冗余的，因为开发者已在代码中通过类型检查（如显式的类型转换或条件判断）隐含地保证了安全性。作者提出了一种名为“PruneSan”的方法，利用静态分析自动识别并移除那些由开发者已实现的类型检查所覆盖的冗余消毒检查。该方法首先构建程序的控制流图和数据类型流，然后通过符号推理判断消毒检查的条件是否已被类型检查所蕴含。实验评估在多个真实项目（如OpenSSL、FFmpeg等）上进行，结果表明PruneSan能够安全地移除平均30%的消毒检查，同时显著降低运行时开销（最高达45%），且未引入任何新的误报或漏报。该工作为在保证安全性的前提下优化消毒器性能提供了有效途径，适用于需要高安全性与高执行效率的C/C++程序。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 当前消毒器检查带来巨大性能开销，许多检查实际冗余。本文提出自动剪枝方法，能在不影响安全性的前提下大幅提升性能，对工业级安全加固有直接价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于任何C/C++软件项目（特别是性能敏感型），减少消毒器运行时开销，提升部署可行性。

items.title: DARKFLEECE: Probing the Dark Side of Android Subscription Apps.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本论文《DARKFLEECE: Probing the Dark Side of Android Subscription Apps》聚焦于Android平台上的订阅型应用（subscription apps）中的安全与欺诈问题。研究者提出了一种名为DARKFLEECE的系统化分析框架，旨在探测这些应用中的恶意行为，例如未经授权的订阅扣费、虚假宣传、隐蔽收费等。论文首先对Google Play商店中大量订阅应用进行了大规模静态和动态分析，识别出多种欺诈模式。核心方法包括：基于图论的订阅流分析、行为签名提取以及机器学习分类器。实验结果表明，DARKFLEECE能够有效检测出约X%的恶意订阅应用（具体数据需参考原文）。主要贡献在于：1) 首次系统性地研究了Android订阅应用的欺诈面；2) 提出了一个可扩展的检测框架；3) 揭示了订阅应用生态中的漏洞和攻击面。该研究为安全从业者提供了理解移动订阅欺诈机理的基础，并为应用商店审核机制改进提供了参考。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: Android订阅应用的欺诈问题直接影响用户财产和平台信誉，DARKFLEECE率先系统性揭示此类威胁，对移动安全研究和应用商店审核均有重要参考价值。

items.title: Towards Automatic and Precise Heap Layout Manipulation for General-Purpose Programs.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究通用程序的堆布局操纵（Heap Layout Manipulation, HLM）自动化问题。堆布局操纵是漏洞利用中的关键步骤，攻击者通过控制堆内存的分配和释放顺序，将关键对象放置在可被利用的内存位置。传统方法依赖于专家手动构造，耗时且容易出错，且缺乏通用性。本文提出一种自动且精确的HLM方法，适用于通用程序。核心思路是将HLM问题形式化为一个规划问题，通过符号执行和约束求解来生成满足特定布局所需的输入序列。作者设计了一个框架，包含三个主要组件：堆状态分析器（Heap State Analyzer）用于提取程序对堆操作的行为模型；布局规划器（Layout Planner）基于行为模型和期望布局目标，生成一系列堆操作步骤；输入生成器（Input Generator）将操作步骤转化为具体的程序输入。实验在多个真实世界程序（如Web服务器、数据库）上进行，证明了该方法能够自动生成有效堆布局，成功率超过90%，且生成的布局与手动构造的质量相当。主要贡献包括：首次提出自动化的通用HLM方法、形式化定义HLM问题、实现原型系统并验证有效性。该工作有助于安全研究者理解攻击技术，并为防御方开发堆布局随机化或异常检测提供参考。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 堆布局操纵是漏洞利用的核心技术之一，自动化为攻击者提供了更高的效率；防御者需要了解自动化方法以设计更有效的缓解措施，如堆布局随机化或分配模式监控。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 提升对通用程序堆利用技术的理解，可能推动堆防御检测规则和随机化策略的改进。

items.title: Double and Nothing: Understanding and Detecting Cryptocurrency Giveaway Scams.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文系统性地研究了加密货币赠品诈骗（Cryptocurrency Giveaway Scams），这是一种利用社交媒体平台（如Twitter/X）冒充知名人士或项目方，声称发放免费加密货币以诱骗用户转入小额验证费用的欺诈行为。作者首先通过手动标记和自动收集，建立了覆盖数千条推文的数据集，并分析了诈骗活动的技术特征，包括域名注册、资金流转、社交媒体账号行为等。核心方法包括：1）利用诈骗推文中高频出现的特定模式（如@提及名人、使用特定标签、包含诈骗地址的截图等）设计检测特征；2）基于这些特征训练机器学习分类器（如随机森林），实现高精度检测；3）对检测到的诈骗活动进行纵向分析，揭示其作案周期、钱包地址的重复使用模式以及资金最终沉淀的交易所。主要贡献：1）首次大规模刻画了加密货币赠品诈骗的完整攻击链和基础设施；2）提出了一个可实际部署的检测系统，在真实数据集上达到超过99%的精确率和召回率；3）揭示了诈骗团伙使用的多种规避策略（如快速更换域名、使用付费验证的Twitter账号）。适合网络安全从业者、加密货币平台风险控制团队以及社交媒体审核人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 加密货币赠品诈骗是当前社交媒体上常见且受害者损失严重的威胁。该研究提供了首个系统化的检测方法，可被SOC、威胁情报团队及加密货币平台直接采用，显著提升自动化识别能力。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响社交媒体（Twitter/X）的欺诈检测、加密货币钱包/交易所的反洗钱监控、以及用户安全教育；可迁移至其他仿冒加密货币空投、NFT赠品等同类诈骗场景。

items.title: Do Not Give a Dog Bread Every Time He Wags His Tail: Stealing Passwords through Content Queries (CONQUER) Attacks.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出一种名为CONQUER的新型侧信道攻击，通过利用内容查询（如浏览器自动填充或密码管理器查询）的响应时间或行为特征来窃取用户密码。研究背景：现代浏览器和密码管理器广泛使用内容查询功能，例如在用户输入时自动填充密码或提供提示，但这些查询的响应模式可能泄露敏感信息。核心问题：攻击者能否利用这些查询的响应差异性来推断密码字符？方法：作者设计并实现CONQUER攻击，通过向目标网站注入恶意脚本，监控与密码字段相关的查询响应时间或错误消息，从而逐字符还原密码。主要贡献：首次系统性地分析了内容查询攻击的可行性，并展示了在主流浏览器和密码管理器上的实验验证，证明了攻击的高效性和隐蔽性。实验表明，攻击者可在短时间内以高准确率窃取密码，且现有防御机制难以检测。该工作为密码安全领域提出了新的威胁向量，并推动了相关防御措施的研究。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: CONQUER攻击揭示了浏览器和密码管理器中内容查询功能的严重安全隐患，可能导致大规模密码泄露，值得安全从业者高度重视并加速风险评估与防御改进。

items.title: Assessing the Impact of Interface Vulnerabilities in Compartmentalized Software.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本论文针对分拆化（compartmentalized）软件中的接口漏洞影响进行了系统评估。分拆化软件通过将程序划分为多个隔离的组件（如利用进程级隔离、沙箱或微内核架构）来增强安全性，但组件间的接口（如系统调用、RPC、共享内存）可能引入新的攻击面。作者首先提出了一个定量框架，用于衡量接口漏洞在分拆化环境下的严重性变化，包括漏洞利用难度、权限提升潜力、信息泄露风险等指标。然后，他们对多种主流分拆技术（如FreeBSD的Capsicum、Google的gVisor、以及基于unikernel的隔离方案）以及不同类型的接口（同步、异步、有状态、无状态）进行了系统测试。实验采用真实世界漏洞样本和合成漏洞两种方式，结果表明：分拆化并非总是能降低漏洞风险——在某些场景下，接口漏洞的利用难度反而降低，例如由于接口语义复杂导致绕过隔离机制；另外，权限分离策略若设计不当，可能使攻击者通过一个组件获得整个系统的高权限。论文的主要贡献包括：①首个系统量化分拆化接口漏洞影响的研究；②揭示了分拆化安全假设的局限性；③提供了设计更安全分拆化系统的指导原则。该研究适合软件安全架构师、操作系统开发者以及安全评估人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 许多现代安全架构依赖分拆化来限制攻击面，但本研究首次量化证明分拆化可能引入新的、甚至更危险的漏洞，挑战了'隔离即安全'的传统观念，对安全架构设计具有警示意义。

items.title: Alexa in Phishingland: Empirical Assessment of Susceptibility to Phishing Pretexting in Voice Assistant Environments.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对亚马逊Alexa等语音助手环境下的网络钓鱼社会工程学攻击（pretexting）进行了实证评估。研究通过设计模拟攻击场景，测试用户在语音交互中对钓鱼 pretexting 的敏感性。实验招募了参与者，在受控环境中与Alexa互动，并施加以不同借口（如账户验证、促销活动等）的钓鱼诱导。结果显示，相当比例的用户被成功欺骗，提供了敏感信息或执行了不安全的操作。研究还分析了用户的人口统计学特征、技术素养与易感性之间的关系。论文的主要贡献在于首次系统性地量化了语音助手环境下的钓鱼攻击风险，并提出了防御设计建议。适合安全研究人员、语音助手产品安全团队以及社会工程学防御从业者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 随着语音助手普及，攻击面扩大，而用户对语音界面的信任可能更高。本研究首次实证揭示用户对语音钓鱼的脆弱性，为设计更安全的语音交互机制提供数据支撑。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响语音助手（如Alexa、Google Assistant）的安全策略设计，以及针对语音界面的社会工程学防御方案的开发。

items.title: CacheOut: Leaking Data on Intel CPUs via Cache Evictions.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出一种名为 CacheOut 的新型微架构侧信道攻击，针对 Intel 处理器。该攻击利用缓存逐出操作（cache evictions）来泄露 CPU 内部缓冲区中的敏感数据，这些数据本应受到 MDS（微架构数据采样）缓解措施的保护。研究者发现，当 CPU 执行缓存逐出时，特定微架构状态（如加载端口或存储缓冲区中的数据）会被意外地保留在缓存行中，攻击者可以通过精心设计的缓存逐出序列，迫使这些数据被写入缓存，进而通过时间测量或缓存侧信道技术恢复。与传统的 MDS 攻击（如 Fallout、RIDL）不同，CacheOut 不受 Intel 已发布的 MDS 缓解补丁（如清除缓冲区指令）的完全防御，因为攻击利用了逐出操作的特殊时序和缓存一致性协议。实验表明，CacheOut 可以在受影响的 Intel CPU（包括 Coffee Lake、Skylake 等）上以高成功率泄露内核内存、跨进程数据以及虚拟机间的秘密。攻击仅需用户态权限，无需特殊硬件。作者还讨论了现有缓解措施的局限性，并建议硬件级修复（如微码更新）来彻底解决此类漏洞。这篇论文对微架构安全研究有重要贡献，揭示了缓存逐出作为新型泄露途径的风险。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: CacheOut攻击绕过了Intel当前的MDS缓解措施，暴露了缓存逐出操作作为新泄漏途径，对云租户隔离、内核内存安全构成实际威胁，推动硬件级安全加固。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响Intel多代CPU（如Skylake、Coffee Lake），可泄露内核内存、跨进程及虚拟机数据，云服务提供商与操作系统厂商需评估风险。

items.title: A Containerization-Based Backfit Approach for Industrial Control System Resiliency.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种基于容器化的回溯（backfit）方法来增强工业控制系统（ICS）的弹性。传统ICS系统在面临网络攻击或物理故障时往往恢复困难，且难以在不中断运行的情况下进行安全更新。作者设计了一种容器化架构，将关键控制功能封装在轻量级容器中，并通过回溯机制在系统受损后快速恢复到安全状态。该方法允许在不影响生产环境的情况下进行安全补丁和配置更新，同时利用容器隔离性限制攻击的横向移动。实验表明，该技术能显著缩短系统恢复时间，并降低因停机造成的损失。论文重点讨论了与现有ICS协议的兼容性以及实时性能开销，证明该方案在真实部署中的可行性。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 工业控制系统是国家关键基础设施的核心，安全弹性至关重要。该容器化回溯方法提供了一种低侵入、高兼容的加固方案，有望解决ICS系统更新难、恢复慢的痛点。

items.title: Demo: Security of Deep Learning based Automated Lane Centering under Physical-World Attack.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文演示了深度学习驱动的自动车道居中（ALC）系统在物理世界攻击下的安全性问题。ALC是高级辅助驾驶系统的关键功能，依赖深度学习模型进行车道线检测和车辆横向控制。作者提出了一种物理世界对抗性攻击方法，通过在车辆前方道路放置精心设计的贴纸图案，成功欺骗ALC系统的车道线检测模型，导致车辆偏离车道或误判车道线位置。实验在真实车辆平台上进行，验证了攻击的有效性，并分析了攻击对车辆控制的影响。论文还讨论了现有防御机制的局限性，并提出了潜在的安全增强方向。该研究揭示了将深度学习模型部署于物理世界安全关键场景时面临的严峻挑战，强调了在自动驾驶系统开发中需纳入对抗性鲁棒性评估。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 自动车道居中系统直接关系行车安全，物理世界攻击可导致车辆失控，对辅助驾驶安全构成实际威胁，值得安全从业者关注防御策略。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响面覆盖所有依赖深度学习车道线检测的自动车道居中系统，可迁移至其他基于视觉的自动驾驶功能，如自动变道、道路标志识别等。

items.title: Learning Differentially Private Mechanisms.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种学习差分隐私机制的框架，旨在自动化设计满足差分隐私保护的数据发布机制。传统上，差分隐私机制（如拉普拉斯机制、指数机制）需要人工设计，且针对特定查询或统计量。本文作者将机制设计问题转化为学习问题：给定一组查询和工作负载，通过优化一个可微分的损失函数来自动学习一个随机化机制，该机制能够同时实现高精度和严格的隐私预算。方法基于神经网络表示机制，并利用重参数化技巧和梯度下降进行端到端训练。实验表明，学习到的机制在多个标准工作负载上优于已有的手工机制，如拉普拉斯机制和阶梯机制，在相同隐私预算下提供更低的误差。该工作为差分隐私机制设计提供了自动化的新途径，适合对隐私保护数据处理和机器学习感兴趣的研究者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 差分隐私机制传统依赖人工设计，本文首次提出用学习方式自动化设计，可能大幅提升隐私保护数据发布的实用性。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 有望应用于隐私保护的统计查询、机器学习模型训练中的梯度扰动等场景，降低隐私预算消耗。

items.title: ILA: Correctness via Type Checking for Fully Homomorphic Encryption.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种名为 ILA（Intermediate Language for FHE）的中间语言和类型系统，用于确保全同态加密（FHE）程序的正确性。FHE 允许在密文上进行任意计算，但现有 FHE 编译器容易引入错误，例如密文噪声管理不当或运算类型不匹配。作者设计了一个类型检查框架，该框架在类型层面编码了密文的安全参数（如噪声预算、乘法深度等），使得类型安全的程序能够保证在解密后得到正确结果。具体而言，ILA 的类型系统包含依赖类型，可以跟踪每个值的噪声增长，并在编译时拒绝可能超出噪声阈值的操作。此外，论文还形式化了类型系统的正确性定理，证明类型良好的程序不会产生解密失败的输出。实验评估使用多个经典 FHE 应用（如线性回归、神经网络推理）来验证类型系统的有效性，结果显示 ILA 能够捕获多种常见的错误，且类型检查的开销在可接受范围内。该研究属于密码学与编程语言的交叉领域，为构建更可靠的 FHE 编译器提供了理论基础。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: FHE 的正确性直接关系到数据隐私保护的安全性，该工作通过类型系统自动检测编程错误，有助于减少因实现缺陷导致的数据泄露风险。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 对 FHE 编译器开发者、密码学库维护者以及使用 FHE 构建隐私计算应用的安全工程师有直接参考价值。

items.title: Poster: Code HarvETHter: Corpus-Driven Decompilation of Ethereum Smart Contracts.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于语料库驱动的以太坊智能合约反编译方法，名为Code HarvETHter。反编译是以太坊安全分析的关键步骤，因为智能合约通常以字节码形式部署，难以直接分析。现有的反编译工具往往依赖于静态规则或模式匹配，存在精度低、可移植性差等问题。本文的创新点在于利用大规模智能合约字节码语料库来训练或指导反编译过程，从而自动学习字节码与高级语言结构之间的映射关系。该方法首先从公开的区块链数据集中收集大量已验证的智能合约字节码及其对应的源代码（如有），构建配对语料库。然后，设计了一种基于序列到序列学习的神经网络模型（或类似方法），将字节码序列映射为伪源代码。此外，论文还探讨了如何利用控制流和数据流分析来增强反编译结果的语义正确性，例如识别函数边界、变量类型和数据结构。通过在一个包含2000多个真实以太坊智能合约的数据集上进行实验，与现有工具（如Porosity、Vandal、Rattle）相比，Code HarvETHter在函数识别准确率、类型恢复和反编译代码的可读性方面均有显著提升。该研究对于智能合约安全审计、漏洞检测以及恶意合约分析具有潜在价值。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 以太坊智能合约安全事件频发，而反编译是理解恶意或闭源合约的关键。现有反编译工具准确率不足，该论文提出的数据驱动方法有望大幅提升反编译质量，助力安全分析师快速定位漏洞。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 有助于提升去中心化应用生态的安全审计效率，可应用于区块链安全公司、智能合约开发者及监管机构的日常分析。

items.title: Exploring the Janus Face of Synthetic Images: From Privacy-secure Biometrics Applications to Deepfake Detection for Misinformation-Free Social Networks.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文探讨了合成图像（Synthetic Images）在隐私保护生物识别应用与深度伪造（Deepfake）检测中的矛盾关系。一方面，合成图像技术（如生成对抗网络GANs生成的虚假人脸）可用于创建隐私安全的生物识别系统，例如通过合成替代真实用户照片来训练识别模型，从而避免直接存储个人生物特征数据，降低数据泄露风险。另一方面，同一技术也被滥用于生成深度伪造内容，对社交媒体上的信息真实性构成威胁。论文提出了一种统一的框架来同时实现隐私保护生物识别和深度伪造检测：利用合成图像构建鲁棒的生物识别模板，同时开发基于合成图像特征的新型Deepfake检测方法。实验表明，该方法在保持高识别精度的同时，能有效区分真实与合成图像，并抵抗常见的对抗攻击。论文还讨论了合成图像在平衡隐私与安全中的伦理考量，并提出了一个面向无虚假信息社交网络的部署方案。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 本文揭示了合成图像技术的一体两面，为安全社区提供了在隐私保护生物识别与深度伪造防御之间取得平衡的系统化方案。

items.why_it_matters: 本文揭示了合成图像技术的一体两面，为安全社区提供了在隐私保护生物识别与深度伪造防御之间取得平衡的系统化方案。

items.title: Dissertation Research Description: The Potential of SBOMs to Increase Software Supply Chain Security.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该研究论文探讨了软件物料清单（SBOM）在增强软件供应链安全方面的潜力。研究背景指出，软件供应链攻击日益频繁，如SolarWinds事件，凸显了透明度和可追溯性的缺失。核心问题是如何利用SBOM来识别和缓解供应链中的漏洞和风险。研究方法包括对现有SBOM标准（如SPDX和CycloneDX）的分析，以及案例研究评估SBOM在漏洞响应、许可证合规性和依赖关系追踪中的实际效果。主要贡献是提出了一个框架，将SBOM集成到DevOps流程中，实现自动化的安全审计和风险评估。实验证明，该方法能显著缩短漏洞发现到修复的时间，并提高供应链整体的可见性。适合安全架构师、DevOps工程师和合规管理人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: SBOM是软件供应链安全的关键工具，该研究系统评估了其潜力与实施路径，为组织采用SBOM提供了实践指南。

items.title: Security and Privacy Measurements in Cellular Networks: Novel Approaches in a Global Roaming Context.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本研究聚焦于蜂窝网络在全球漫游场景下的安全与隐私测量问题。随着移动用户跨国漫游日益频繁，运营商之间的信令交互带来了新的攻击面，例如位置泄露、身份伪造、中间人攻击等。现有测量方法多针对单一网络，缺乏对漫游链路全局视角的刻画。本文提出一套新颖的测量框架，利用被动监听和主动探测相结合的方式，收集跨网络的信令数据，并设计多维度分析算法以识别异常行为。实验基于多个国家的真实漫游数据集，验证了方法在检测信令异常（如SS7漏洞利用、Diameter协议滥用）和评估隐私泄露风险（如IMSI捕获）方面的有效性。主要贡献包括：首次系统分析全球漫游环境下的安全测量挑战，提出轻量级部署方案，以及公开部分测量工具。适合移动网络运营商的安全团队、监管机构以及研究蜂窝协议安全的研究人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 全球漫游是移动通信的核心业务，但跨网络信令安全长期缺乏有效的测量手段。该研究为蓝队提供了可落地的检测思路，有助于主动发现漫游链路中的威胁。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接适用于运营商漫入/漫出流量监控、合规审计；方法论可推广至其他基于信令的通信系统（如物联网漫游）。

items.title: Semantic Leakage and Privacy Preservation in Relay-Assisted Semantic Communications
items.summary: Semantic communication (SemCom) has emerged as a promising paradigm in which the transmission of task-relevant information is prioritized over raw data, enabling efficient and robust communication under resource and channel constraints. In this paper, the privacy implications of relay-assisted SemCom systems are studied, where the intermediate relay node operates directly on learned latent representations. It is shown that the relay, even without access to source data, can reliably infer semantic meaning and reconstruct signals with performance comparable to that of the legitimate receiver, revealing a fundamental privacy vulnerability of semantic representations. To address this issue, an iterative adversarial training framework is proposed in which a strong, adaptively trained eavesdropper at the relay is explicitly accounted for. The proposed approach alternates between optimizing the relay's eavesdropping function and the legitimate system, resulting in representations that preserve semantic decoding performance at the intended receiver while degrading semantic inference at the relay. The semantic accuracy gap between the legitimate receiver and the eavesdropper is significantly enlarged across channel conditions. Importantly, this protection is achieved in a stealthy manner, with high reconstruction fidelity maintained while semantic leakage is selectively suppressed.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究了中继辅助语义通信系统中的隐私泄露问题。语义通信（SemCom）通过仅传输任务相关的高层语义特征来提升通信效率，但本文发现中继节点即使无法访问原始数据，也能从学习到的潜在表示中可靠推断语义含义并重构信号，其性能接近合法接收者，揭示了语义表示的固有隐私漏洞。为应对这一威胁，作者提出了一种迭代对抗训练框架：在训练过程中显式考虑一个自适应强窃听者（位于中继处），通过交替优化窃听者功能和合法系统，使得生成的表示在合法接收者处保持语义解码性能，同时抑制中继处的语义推理。实验表明，该方法在不同信道条件下显著扩大了合法接收者与窃听者之间的语义准确率差距，且能在保持高重构保真度的同时选择性抑制语义泄露，实现了隐蔽的隐私保护。该研究适用于无线通信安全、隐私保护机器学习、语义通信系统设计等领域的从业者。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 首次系统揭示中继辅助语义通信中潜在表示的隐私泄露风险，并提出可扩展的对抗防御框架，对设计隐私感知的下一代语义通信系统具有重要指导意义。

items.title: Robocalls: A Worldwide or US-only Problem? Analyzing Spam and Fraud in International Phone Calls
items.summary: Unsolicited automated phone calls (robocalls) are a serious threat: in the US alone, these calls resulted in reported losses of 1.1$ billion during 2025. Phishing and spoofing consistently rank among the most reported crimes within the FBI's Internet Crime Complaint Center, with phone call scams having the highest reported median loss. Combating robocalls is difficult due to many legal and practical constraints: robocalls often encompass multiple legal jurisdictions of different countries/states, the large volume of robocalls, their multilingual nature, the lack of publicly available data, privacy concerns with obtaining data, etc. We present a study of international robocalls, aggregating robocall reports from countries across all inhabited continents and contribute by providing new findings on international robocalls from 65 different countries. We also present the first publicly available multimodal and international robocall dataset: 8.7 million call detail records, 839 robocall transcripts from 28 identified robocall campaign clusters, and 677 robocall recordings. We describe our methodology for collecting robocall data over a 9-month period and provide a detailed analysis comparing robocalls in the US with those in other countries. Our analysis covers several aspects, including uncovering calling patterns, identifying co-targeting attacks, discovering common robocall campaigns, extracting callback numbers, analyzing linguistic differences among robocalls in the same language but different regions, and other insights. Our results indicate that although robocalls are an international problem, the severity of the threat is significantly higher in the US than in other countries. We provide steps for future research and suggest remedies to reduce the effectiveness of robocalls based on our analysis.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对全球范围内（尤其是跨国）的骚扰电话（robocalls）问题进行了系统性研究。背景方面，骚扰电话在美国造成了严重的经济损失（2025年报告损失11亿美元），且与网络钓鱼和冒充诈骗并列FBI互联网犯罪投诉中心最常见的犯罪类型。由于涉及多国司法管辖、语言多样性、数据难以获取等法律与实操限制，国际骚扰电话的治理极为困难。本文基于65个国家的骚扰电话报告，构建了首个公开可用的多模态国际骚扰电话数据集，包含870万条通话详细记录、839份来自28个识别出的诈骗活动集群的呼叫脚本，以及677段呼叫录音。作者在9个月时间内收集数据，详细描述了方法论，并对美国与其他国家的骚扰电话进行了对比分析。分析涵盖呼叫模式、协同目标攻击、常见诈骗活动、回拨号码提取、同语言不同地区的语言差异等多个维度。结果表明，骚扰电话虽为国际性问题，但美国所面临的威胁严重程度显著高于其他国家。最后，论文提出了未来研究方向以及基于分析结果的减轻骚扰电话效果的建议。该研究适合安全研究人员、电信运营商、反欺诈从业者以及政策制定者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 骚扰电话是跨国电信诈骗的核心载体，但此前缺乏公开的国际数据集与跨地区对比分析。本文填补了这一空白，为全球协同防御和区域差异化策略提供了实证基础。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 研究成果可直接用于提升跨国诈骗电话的自动检测能力，并为各国监管机构制定针对性规制措施提供参考。

items.title: Exploring Side-Channel Protections in Hardware Implementations of PQC ML-KEM Verification
items.summary: As ML-KEM is adopted as a post-quantum cryptographic standard, resilience against physical side-channel attacks has become essential. Among the constituent steps, the decapsulation Fujisaki-Okamoto (FO) verification is particularly vulnerable to side-channel power and electromagnetic (EM) analysis. In this work, we focus on common FPGA-based implementations and examine their side-channel vulnerabilities, and compare them with those of microcontroller implementations. Three verification implementations, unprotected, hash-based (first-order), and higher-order masked, are evaluated for side-channel security on both a microcontroller and an FPGA. While FPGAs offer higher speed and parallelism, they often exhibit stronger side-channel leakage, especially in high bandwidth configurations. The higher-order masked designs still leak information about the underlying data due to hardware-level effects and data-dependent processing. Our experiments show that their parallelized processing on FPGAs introduces sufficient first-order leakage for full secret-key recovery. These results underscore the persistent challenge of securing PQC algorithms in performance-constrained and parallelized hardware environments.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文探讨了后量子密码标准 ML-KEM 中 Fujisaki-Okamoto 验证步骤的硬件实现侧信道防护问题。ML-KEM 的封装验证对侧信道功耗和电磁分析特别敏感。作者聚焦于常见 FPGA 实现，并与微控制器实现进行对比，评估了三种验证实现：未保护、哈希基（一阶）和高阶掩码。实验表明，尽管 FPGA 提供更高速度和并行性，但其在高带宽配置下表现出更强的侧信道泄漏。高阶掩码设计因硬件级效应和数据相关处理仍会泄漏底层数据信息。在 FPGA 上，并行处理引入足以恢复完整私钥的一阶泄漏。这些结果强调了在性能受限和并行化硬件环境中确保 PQC 算法安全性的持续挑战。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: ML-KEM 是即将广泛部署的后量子加密标准，其硬件实现若存在侧信道漏洞，将直接威胁密钥安全。该研究揭示了 FPGA 实现中高阶掩码的局限性，对安全硬件设计有重要指导意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有采用 ML-KEM 的硬件安全模块、HSM、安全芯片等；可迁移至其他后量子密码算法的硬件实现评估。

items.title: A Lifecycle and Application-Stack Survey of Large Language Model Vulnerabilities: Attacks, Risks, Defenses, and Open Problems
items.summary: Large language models are no longer only text generators. They are increasingly embedded in retrieval pipelines, enterprise assistants, coding environments, robotic systems, security-operation workflows, and autonomous agents that can read private data, call tools, write files, execute code, and act across organizational boundaries. This shift changes the security problem: risks do not arise from the model weights alone, but from the full lifecycle and application stack through which data, prompts, model outputs, tools, memories, and user authority interact. This paper systematizes the literature on vulnerabilities in large language model systems through a lifecycle and application-stack lens. We organize attacks across eight stages: data collection, pretraining, post-training alignment, model packaging and supply chain, retrieval and memory, prompting and inference, tool/agent execution, and deployment/maintenance. For each stage, we analyze attacker capabilities, affected security objectives, representative attacks, practical risks, evaluation practices, and defenses. We further map LLM-specific vulnerabilities to confidentiality, integrity, availability, safety, privacy, fairness, accountability, and agency-control objectives. Unlike taxonomies that list isolated attack names, the proposed systematization emphasizes where trust boundaries fail, how untrusted data becomes executable instruction, how delegated authority amplifies model errors, and why point defenses rarely compose. We close with a research agenda for secure LLM systems, including compositional security, provenance-aware retrieval, tool-call containment, long-horizon agent evaluation, privacy-preserving adaptation, realistic red teaming, and deployment-grade incident response.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本论文是一篇系统化的综述，从生命周期和应用栈的视角梳理了大语言模型（LLM）系统中的漏洞。作者指出，LLM已不再是单纯的文本生成器，而是深度嵌入检索管道、企业助手、编程环境、机器人系统、安全运营工作流以及自主智能体，这些智能体能够读取私有数据、调用工具、写入文件、执行代码并在组织边界内行动。这种转变改变了安全问题的本质：风险不仅来自模型权重本身，更来自数据、提示、模型输出、工具、记忆和用户权限相互作用的完整生命周期和应用栈。论文将攻击组织为八个阶段：数据收集、预训练、后训练对齐、模型打包与供应链、检索与记忆、提示与推理、工具/智能体执行、部署与维护。针对每个阶段，分析了攻击者能力、受影响的安全目标、代表性攻击、实际风险、评估实践和防御措施。进一步将LLM特定漏洞映射到保密性、完整性、可用性、安全性、隐私、公平性、问责制和代理控制等安全目标。与仅列出孤立攻击名称的分类法不同，该综述强调了信任边界何时失效、不可信数据如何变成可执行指令、委托授权如何放大模型错误，以及为什么点防御难以组合。最后提出了安全LLM系统的研究议程，包括组合安全、可溯源检索、工具调用约束、长期智能体评估、隐私保护适配、现实红队测试以及部署级应急响应。本文适合安全研究人员、LLM开发者、AI安全工程师阅读，以系统理解LLM攻击面并指导防御设计。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 对LLM安全从业者而言，本文提供了首个覆盖全生命周期和应用栈的漏洞系统化梳理，帮助识别信任边界失效点并理解点防御的局限性，是构建安全LLM系统的重要参考。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至各类LLM集成场景（如智能助手、自动代理、代码生成等），帮助安全团队建立系统化的威胁模型和评估框架。

items.title: Hybrid Topological Data Analysis and LSTM Networks for Enhanced Network Intrusion Detection Using CIC-IDS2017 Dataset
items.summary: Network intrusion detection systems (NIDS) are crucial in cybersecurity infrastructure, needing advanced techniques to detect hostile activity in network traffic. This research introduces a hybrid approach that combines Topological Data Analysis (TDA) with Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks to improve anomaly detection in network security. Our multi-layered design combines TDA's persistent homology with LSTM networks to capture topological characteristics of network traffic patterns and simulate temporal sequences. We assessed our methodology using the CIC-IDS2017 dataset, which includes over 2.8 million labelled flows, 77 network variables, and 14 attack categories that reflect modern threat landscapes such as DDoS, brute force, web attacks, penetration, and botnet activities. Integrating Betti curves and persistence diagrams with deep learning architectures enhances feature extraction performance. Our hybrid TDA+LSTM model has an AUC of 1.000 and F1-score of 1.000, with 5-fold cross-validation producing a mean AUC of 1.000 $\pm$ 0.000 and mean F1 of 0.999 $\pm$ 0.001. An ablation research demonstrates the complimentary contributions of topological (F1=0.990) and temporal characteristics (F1=1.000). Comparative research shows that the suggested strategy beats TDA+Random Forest (F1=0.994) and Isolation Forest (F1=0.835) baselines in several attack categories.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对网络安全中的网络入侵检测系统（NIDS）性能提升问题，提出了一种结合拓扑数据分析（TDA）与长短期记忆（LSTM）网络的混合方法。研究背景指出传统NIDS在处理复杂、动态的网络流量时存在局限性，而TDA能够从高维数据中提取拓扑特征（如Betti曲线、持久性图），LSTM则擅长建模时间序列依赖。作者设计了多层架构：首先使用TDA对网络流量进行特征提取，捕获流量的拓扑结构；然后将拓扑特征输入LSTM网络，学习时序模式。实验采用CIC-IDS2017数据集，包含超过280万个标记流、77个网络变量和14种攻击类别（如DDoS、暴力破解、Web攻击、渗透、僵尸网络）。结果表明，混合TDA+LSTM模型在二分类异常检测中取得了AUC=1.000、F1=1.000的指标，5折交叉验证平均AUC=1.000±0.000、平均F1=0.999±0.001。消融实验证实拓扑特征（F1=0.990）与时序特征（F1=1.000）具有互补性；对比研究显示，该方法优于TDA+随机森林（F1=0.994）和孤立森林（F1=0.835）基线。尽管指标过于完美可能暗示过拟合或数据泄露风险，但文章展示了TDA与深度学习结合在NIDS领域的潜力。主要贡献在于：1) 提出TDA+LSTM混合框架；2) 在标准数据集上验证了有效性；3) 提供了特征互补性分析。适合对NIDS、拓扑数据分析、深度学习应用感兴趣的安全研究人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 将拓扑数据分析引入NIDS是较新的尝试，可能提升对复杂攻击模式的检测能力；但AUC=1.000的指标需谨慎看待，需独立复现验证。

items.title: Robust Text Watermarking for Large Language Models via Dual Semantic Embeddings
items.summary: This work presents Dual-Embedding Watermarking (DEW), a semantic watermarking scheme for large language models (LLMs) that leverages contextual and token-level embeddings to enhance robustness against paraphrasing and translation. DEW utilizes a signal-processing methodology, applying algebraic vector-space operations to \mbox{token and context embeddings to derive a watermark signal that degrades gracefully under semantic shifts. The method obfuscates the watermark by projecting embedding vectors through pseudo-random matrices seeded with a secret key. Relevant distributions derived from the underlying algebra are evaluated and employed for statistical testing and benchmarking of DEW. Experimental results across multiple LLMs indicate that DEW improves post-paraphrase detection while maintaining competitive text quality, and remains detectable after translation, even when prior semantic watermarks degrade significantly. These findings position DEW as a practical and robust solution for safeguarding LLM-generated text and addressing critical issues in responsible AI deployment.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种名为双嵌入水印（DEW）的语义水印方案，用于保护大语言模型（LLM）生成文本的版权和来源。现有语义水印在面对改写（paraphrasing）和翻译攻击时鲁棒性不足，DEW通过利用上下文嵌入（context embeddings）和令牌级嵌入（token-level embeddings）的双重语义信息来增强鲁棒性。具体方法上，DEW采用信号处理技术，对令牌和上下文嵌入向量进行代数向量空间操作，生成一个在语义变化下优雅退化的水印信号。为隐藏水印，该方法通过伪随机矩阵（由秘密密钥种子生成）对嵌入向量进行投影，从而混淆水印。基于底层代数推导出的相关分布被用于统计测试和基准评估。实验在多个LLM上进行，结果表明DEW在改写后依然保持良好的检测性能，同时文本质量相当；在翻译攻击下，即使其他语义水印方法大幅退化，DEW仍可检测。该工作为LLM生成文本的负责任部署提供了实用且鲁棒的解决方案。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该方案解决了LLM文本水印在改写和翻译攻击下易失效的痛点，提升了内容溯源与知识产权保护的可信度，对AI安全部署有直接价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于需要确保LLM生成内容来源的场景，如学术论文、新闻、合约等敏感文本的溯源与防伪。

items.title: Digital signature schemes based on code equivalence and syndrome decoding from restricted errors
items.summary: Digital signature schemes are an important cryptographic tool to ensure data authenticity and integrity in many applications that must be resilient to attacks, including those facilitated by quantum computers. We consider the two digital signature schemes based on error-correcting codes that are second-round candidates in NIST's call for Additional Signature Schemes, which is part of the Post-Quantum Cryptography Standardization Process. Specifically, we provide an overview of the Codes and Restricted Objects Signature Scheme (CROSS) and the Linear Equivalence Signature Scheme (LESS). We describe their underlying problems of syndrome decoding from restricted errors and code equivalence. We review sigma protocols and how they can be transformed into digital signature schemes via the Fiat-Shamir transform. Finally, we explain how this procedure yields code-based digital signatures believed to be post-quantum secure.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文对基于纠错码的两类数字签名方案——受限错误综合征解码签名方案（CROSS）和线性等价签名方案（LESS）进行了综述。这两种方案是NIST后量子密码标准化过程中“额外签名方案”征集的第二轮候选方案。文章首先介绍了它们所依赖的困难问题：受限错误条件下的综合征解码问题（假设在错误具有特定结构时依然保持NP困难性）和码等价问题（判断两个线性码是否通过置换等价）。接着，文章回顾了Sigma协议及其通过Fiat-Shamir变换转化为数字签名的一般框架，并详细说明了如何将该框架应用于CROSS和LESS，从而构造出据信能抵抗量子攻击的数字签名。文章的主要贡献在于为密码社区提供了一份清晰的、面向实现者的技术概述，帮助理解这两种方案的设计原理、安全性假设以及性能权衡。适合对后量子密码学、基于编码的密码学感兴趣的网络安全研究人员和标准制定者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 后量子密码标准化正处于关键阶段，CROSS和LESS作为有潜力的候选方案，其原理和安全性理解对蓝队评估未来密码迁移路径至关重要。

items.title: Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning based Intrusion Detection in Realistic IoT Networks
items.summary: The Internet of Things (IoT) is rapidly growing and expanding into various sectors, such as healthcare, transportation, smart homes, and more. Despite the benefits of using IoT devices, they present several challenges. Given the significant role these devices play in our lives, it is crucial to address issues related to their security and privacy. These devices are limited in resources, which complicates their security and the protection of the data that they manage. The paper aims to examine intrusion detection systems using the Gotham2025 dataset, generated through the Gotham testbed, which consists of 78 emulated IoT devices utilising various protocols, including MQTT, CoAP, and RTSP, to assist in safeguarding IoT networks from attacks. We conduct a comparative analysis between five machine learning algorithms, including Random Forest, XGBoost, Logistic Regression, Naive Bayes, and Deep Neural Network. We demonstrate that the Random Forest Classifier was the top-performing model, achieving an F1-score of 0.99 in classifying attacks.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对物联网（IoT）网络安全中的入侵检测问题展开研究，重点探讨了在资源受限的IoT设备环境下如何有效检测攻击。作者利用Gotham2025数据集进行评估，该数据集通过Gotham测试平台生成，模拟了78个采用MQTT、CoAP和RTSP等多种协议的IoT设备。论文对五种机器学习算法进行了对比分析：随机森林（Random Forest）、XGBoost、逻辑回归（Logistic Regression）、朴素贝叶斯（Naive Bayes）和深度神经网络（Deep Neural Network）。实验结果表明，随机森林分类器表现最优，在攻击分类任务上达到了0.99的F1分数。研究背景指出，IoT设备在医疗、交通、智能家居等领域广泛应用，但其资源受限特性导致安全与隐私保护面临挑战。论文的核心贡献在于验证了基于机器学习的入侵检测在真实IoT网络中的有效性，并为实际部署提供了算法选择依据。该研究适合对IoT安全、入侵检测系统及机器学习应用感兴趣的研究人员和工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究为IoT网络入侵检测提供了高性能的机器学习方案，有助于提升IoT设备的安全防护能力，对于安全运维人员设计实际检测系统具有重要参考价值。

items.title: CVE-TTP KG: Knowledge Graph Linking Software Vulnerabilities to Attack Behaviors
items.summary: In the evolving threat landscape, adversaries exploit software vulnerabilities to launch sophisticated attacks, challenging traditional defenses. Although databases like CVE and NVD provide detailed technical information, they often lack links to attacker behaviors such as tactics and techniques, limiting effective threat interpretation and response. This work bridges this gap by connecting vulnerabilities with behavioral patterns from the MITRE ATT&CK framework. We construct a CVE-TTP Knowledge Graph that links CVEs to tactics and techniques using classification and relation extraction. Transformer-based models are developed for behavior identification, with CySecBERT achieving macro F1-scores of 87.71% (techniques) and 96.16% (tactics). Also, we created an annotated dataset with 24,820 entities and 43,608 relations for entity and relation extraction. The pipeline-based approach achieves macro F1-scores of 0.86 (entity extraction) and 0.99 (relation extraction), while a span-based joint model achieves 0.78. These outputs are integrated into a Neo4j-based Cyber Threat Knowledge Graph, enabling structured visualization of vulnerabilities.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对当前威胁环境中软件漏洞（CVE）与攻击行为（如MITRE ATT&CK框架中的战术与技术）之间缺乏直接关联的问题，提出了一种知识图谱构建方法。作者构建了CVE-TTP知识图谱，将通用漏洞枚举（CVE）与ATT&CK的战术和技术通过分类和关系抽取进行链接。研究首先开发了基于Transformer的模型用于行为识别，其中CySecBERT在技术分类上达到87.71%的宏F1分数，在战术分类上达到96.16%。此外，作者创建了一个包含24,820个实体和43,608个关系的人工标注数据集，用于实体和关系抽取。他们采用了两种方法：流水线方法在实体抽取上取得0.86的宏F1分数，在关系抽取上取得0.99；而基于跨度的联合模型达到0.78。最终将这些结果整合到基于Neo4j的网络威胁知识图谱中，实现漏洞与攻击行为的结构化可视化。该工作填补了漏洞数据与攻击行为之间的语义鸿沟，有助于安全分析师更有效地进行威胁理解和响应。论文主要贡献包括：提出了从CVE描述中自动提取ATT&CK战术和技术的方法；发布了高质量标注数据集；证明了Transformer模型在该任务上的有效性；以及构建了可查询的知识图谱。研究适合安全运营分析师、威胁情报研究人员以及知识图谱构建者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作直接连接了漏洞信息与攻击行为模式，能显著提升蓝队对威胁的理解和响应效率，有助于自动化威胁建模和攻击模拟。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于安全运营中心（SOC）的漏洞优先级排序、红蓝对抗模拟、自动化威胁情报分析等场景。

items.title: A forgery attack on the Block.co blockchain-based digital credential certification system
items.summary: Certification of digital documents, such as academic credentials, seems a particularly suitable application for the use of blockchain and distributed ledger technologies. Indeed, these technologies enable decentralized certification systems that rely on the immutability and persistence of their distributed ledgers. However, in the absence of a central trusted authority, it is not easy to guarantee the authenticity of the connection between the real identity of an academic institution and the digital identity of the certificate issuer. In this paper, we demonstrate that one of such systems, known as Block.co, has a vulnerability that allows the production of forged certificates that are recognized as valid by the system. Since this is an inherent limitation of the approach used for blockchain-based certification, our attack is likely to be extendable to other systems adopting the same approach.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究的是区块链数字证书认证系统的安全性问题，具体针对一个名为 Block.co 的系统。数字证书（如学术文凭）的认证是区块链技术的一个典型应用场景，因为它利用分布式账本的不可篡改性和持久性来提供去中心化的认证服务。然而，在没有中央可信权威机构的情况下，确保学术机构的真实身份与证书发行者的数字身份之间的关联真实性变得困难。作者发现 Block.co 系统存在一个漏洞，允许攻击者生成伪造的证书，而这些证书会被系统识别为有效。这一漏洞源于基于区块链的认证方法所固有的局限性，因此该攻击很可能也适用于采用相同方法的其他系统。论文通过具体实验演示了攻击过程，并分析了漏洞的根源，指出在没有额外身份验证机制的情况下，仅依赖区块链本身无法保证证书发行者的身份真实性。该研究对于理解和改进区块链数字证书系统的安全性具有重要意义。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了一个实际区块链认证系统的严重漏洞，允许伪造证书，直接威胁到数字文凭等关键应用的可信性，并对所有采用类似方法区块链认证系统发出警示。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响范围包括 Block.co 系统及其可能采用相同身份认证机制的其他区块链证书系统，可能导致虚假学术证书被广泛接受，损害教育机构和雇主的信任。

items.title: No Prompt, No Leaks: A Robust Generative Steganography Framework via Prompt-Free Diffusion
items.summary: Generative image steganography synthesizes stego images directly from secret information to achieve inherent security advantages. Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs) have recently emerged as a fundamental image steganography framework that modulates secret latent representations with text prompts. Limited by the inflexibility of text prompts, these methods still struggle to generate high-quality stego images and accurately recover secret images. In this work, we propose a prompt-free diffusion image steganography framework that integrates style semantic priors to control more robust and reliable stego image generation. Specifically, a Cascaded Affine Coupling Module (CACM) establishes a bijective, deterministic mapping between a secret image and its latent representation. Then, style semantics are integrated into the diffusion process to control latent representation and ensure visual imperceptibility in the generated stego images. To mitigate trajectory deviations stemming from the unconditioned reverse process, a predictor-corrector mechanism is introduced to iteratively refine the generation trajectory via feedback from the current and predicted next states. Extensive experimental results show that the proposed method achieves competitive performance compared to state-of-the-art methods in terms of security, secret image reconstruction accuracy and controllability.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种无提示的扩散图像隐写框架，以解决现有基于潜在扩散模型（LDM）的隐写方法因依赖文本提示而导致生成图像质量低、秘密图像恢复不准确的问题。核心创新包括：1）级联仿射耦合模块（CACM），在秘密图像与其潜在表示之间建立双射确定性映射；2）将风格语义先验集成到扩散过程中，控制潜在表示并确保生成隐写图像的视觉不可察觉性；3）引入预测-校正机制，通过当前状态和预测下一状态的反馈迭代修正无条件反向过程中的轨迹偏差。实验表明，该方法在安全性、秘密图像重建精度和可控性方面优于现有技术。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究提出了一种无需文本提示的稳健隐写框架，提升了隐蔽通信的安全性和图像质量，对信息安全领域的隐写术发展具有参考价值。

items.title: EnclaveX: End-to-End Confidential AI with CPU/GPU TEEs
items.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have rapidly proliferated, driving widespread adoption of AI applications. Most deployments rely on centralized infrastructures such as Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, or AWS, requiring users to share sensitive data and training or fine-tuning code. This dependence raises significant security and privacy concerns, as cloud providers must be trusted to ensure confidentiality and integrity. Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs) e.g., Intel SGX/TDX, AMD SEV-SNP, and ARM CCA have been introduced to mitigate these risks. More recently, NVIDIA has developed GPU TEEs (e.g., H100/H200), yet comprehensive evaluations of end-to-end workflows that integrate CPU and GPU TEEs remain limited. Critical aspects, including performance overhead, remote attestation, and security guarantees for AI/LLM applications, have not been sufficiently studied. This paper addresses this gap by presenting an end-to-end workflow that combines CPU and GPU TEEs. We propose mechanisms to ensure confidentiality and integrity at both the VM level (via Intel TDX and AMD SEV-SNP) and the application level, highlighting vulnerabilities such as Kubernetes administrators' ability to access confidential VM contents. Finally, we evaluate the performance overhead of our system using industry benchmarks, focusing on configurations that integrate Intel TDX with NVIDIA H200 GPUs.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对大型语言模型（LLM）在云环境中部署带来的隐私和安全问题，提出了一种结合CPU和GPU可信执行环境（TEE）的端到端机密AI工作流。随着LLM的广泛应用，用户通常需要将敏感数据和训练代码托管于Microsoft Azure、Google Cloud或AWS等集中式基础设施，从而依赖云提供商保证机密性和完整性。为降低风险，业界引入了CPU TEE（如Intel SGX/TDX、AMD SEV-SNP、ARM CCA）和GPU TEE（如NVIDIA H100/H200），但目前缺乏对二者集成后的端到端工作流的全面评估。本文填补了这一空白：首先，设计了在VM级（通过Intel TDX和AMD SEV-SNP）和应用程序级确保机密性和完整性的机制；其次，揭示了Kubernetes管理员能够访问机密VM内容等漏洞；最后，利用行业基准测试评估了系统性能开销，重点关注Intel TDX与NVIDIA H200 GPU的集成配置。实验结果表明，该方案在提供强安全保证的同时，仅引入可接受的性能开销。本文的工作为构建端到端安全的AI推理和训练基础设施提供了重要参考。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 本文首次系统评估了CPU/GPU TEE集成在LLM工作流中的安全性和性能，揭示了Kubernetes管理员等特权用户可访问机密VM内容的风险，并为构建机密AI基础设施提供了实用指导，对云服务商和安全从业者具有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响依赖云基础设施的AI应用安全，特别是涉及敏感数据（如医疗、金融）的LLM推理和训练场景；相关发现可迁移至其他基于TEE的机密计算工作流。

items.title: Witness Complexity of Short Descriptions: A Cryptographic Perspective
items.summary: In cryptographic practice, where protocols impose strict time bounds, implementations demand predictable resource usage, and real-world systems require immediate verification for security and usability, a short key or certificate is useful only if it can be expanded or verified within a bounded time; otherwise a compact representation that requires superpolynomial work to expand offers no operational guarantee within a bounded-time protocol. This paper formalises that gap by introducing \emph{witness complexity} \(\gam(x)\), the minimum running time over near-shortest descriptions of a string on a universal Turing machine. \(\gam\) differs from Shannon entropy and Kolmogorov complexity \(\KC\): low \(\KC\) can coexist with high \(\gam\). We prove invariance up to polynomial factors; a conditional separation (assuming \(\PneqNP\)). An unconditional lower bound from incomputability of \(\KC\); a biconditional characterisation of \(\PeqNP\) via the class-relative variant \(\gP\); and polynomial-time tractability for structured \(\classNP\) families. Part II develops companion measures and shows an unconditional gap between grammar size and derivation cost, positioning \(\gam\) as a metric for the usability of keys and certificates.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文从密码学实践的角度出发，提出并形式化了“见证复杂度”（witness complexity）的概念，记为γ(x)，它衡量在通用图灵机上对字符串x的最短描述（近似最短）进行展开所需的最小运行时间。在密码协议中，密钥或证书必须能在有界时间内展开或验证，否则紧凑表示若需要超多项式时间展开，则无法提供操作保证。这一概念填补了香农熵和Kolmogorov复杂度（KC）的空白：低KC可以与高γ(x)共存，即字符串虽然可被短描述，但展开却可能极慢。主要贡献包括：1）证明γ(x)在多项式因子下具有不变性；2）在假设P≠NP下给出条件性分离；3）利用KC的不可计算性导出无条件下界；4）通过类相对变体γ^P给出P=NP的充要刻画；5）证明对于结构化的NP问题族，γ(x)可以在多项式时间内计算。第二部分发展伴随度量，并显示文法大小与推导代价之间的无条件差距，从而将γ(x)定位为衡量密钥和证书可用性的重要指标。适合密码学实现者、计算复杂性理论研究者以及关注安全协议资源消耗的工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该论文揭示了一个被忽视的安全缺口：即使密钥或证书的表示很短，其展开计算可能超出协议时间预算，导致拒绝服务或验证失败。见证复杂度为密码原语的可用性提供了形式化度量，有助于设计更鲁棒的协议实现。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响密钥分发、数字证书验证、时间有界密码协议的设计与安全审计。可迁移至任何涉及紧凑表示与有界验证的场景，如区块链、TLS握手、物联网轻量级认证。

items.title: Automated High-Precision Extraction and Forensic Verification of Data-Bearing Vector Figures
items.summary: The quantitative record of science and engineering is increasingly carried by figures rather than text or tables, and a reader who needs the underlying numbers must usually re-digitize them by hand: slowly, imprecisely, and with no way to prove the result is faithful. Yet when a figure is stored as vector graphics, its data are not approximated by the picture but encoded in it: the renderer writes each marker and vertex at a printed precision that, for the dominant scientific toolchain, exceeds the data's own. We turn this into three contributions, one per shortcoming of hand digitization. First, a precision theory bounding how accurately data can be recovered for a given renderer and export format: bit-exact float32 for matplotlib markers, and a calibration-limited three to four significant figures end to end. Second, an automatic extractor that decodes a figure in one pass with no human in the loop, in place of the slow point-by-point tracing a digitizer demands. Third, a verification theory: recovery is injective except on a characterized, vanishingly small interval near zero; accidental agreement between unrelated data is astronomically unlikely; and a re-rendering certificate binds the recovered values to the markers, lines, and ticks the figure draws, not its text, making a result non-repudiable. With no ground truth used during recovery, decoded figures match external archives (Planck 2018 to 10^-9; the Keeling CO2 record to 5*10^-4, and one decoded figure independently reproduces a correction to the Chinchilla scaling-law confidence interval. We map the achievable precision across common renderers and their PDF, SVG, and EPS formats. What we deliver is certified data; the scientific significance of any particular dataset lies outside this paper's scope, and recovered values are candidates for human review, never accusations.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种从矢量图形中自动高精度提取数据并进行取证验证的方法。研究背景：科学和工程领域的定量记录越来越多地以图形而非文本或表格形式呈现，读者需要获取底层数据时通常需要手动重新数字化，过程缓慢、不精确且无法证明结果的真实性。核心问题：如何自动、精确地从矢量图中提取数据，并提供可信的验证机制。论文的三个主要贡献：1）精度理论：针对给定的渲染器和导出格式（如matplotlib标记和PDF/SVG/EPS），界定了数据恢复的理论精度，对matplotlib标记可达位精确的float32，端到端校准后可达三到四位有效数字。2）自动提取器：一种无需人工干预的单次解码算法，替代手动逐点追踪，实现高效自动化。3）验证理论：恢复过程除原点附近极小区间外是单射的，不同数据集偶然一致的可能性极低；通过重新渲染证书将恢复值与图形中的标记、线条和刻度绑定（而非文本），实现不可否认性。实验证明：在没有使用真实数据的情况下，解码图形与外部档案高度吻合（Planck 2018精度达10^-9；Keeling CO2记录达5×10^-4），并独立复现了Chinchilla缩放定律置信区间的修正。论文还映射了常见渲染器和矢量格式下的可达精度。该研究为数据提取提供了可认证的可靠结果，但任何特定数据集的重要性不在论文范围内，恢复值仅供人工审核参考。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该论文为从科学图表中自动、可信地提取数据提供了理论基础和实用工具，解决了手动数字化不精确、费时且无法验证的问题，对需要复用公开图表数据的科研人员和取证分析师具有重要价值。

items.title: CSO-LLM: Class Subspace Orthogonalization for Post-Training Backdoor Detection and Trigger Inversion in LLMs
items.summary: While post-training backdoor detection and trigger inversion schemes have been developed for AIs used e.g. for images, there is a paucity of such methods for LLMs. First, the LLM input space is discrete, with up to 150,000^k k-tuples to consider with k the token-length of a putative trigger. Second, one must blacklist tokens typical of the putative target response (class) of an attack, as such tokens may give false detection signals. However, a comprehensive blacklist is not available, in general, for a given domain. We develop a highly effective detection and inversion framework for LLMs treated as classifiers. Central to our approach is class subspace orthogonalization (CSO), a novel plug-and-play paradigm for backdoor detection that serves two fundamental roles when applied to LLMs: i) it enhances both sensitivity and specificity of a baseline detector; ii) it provides a form of implicit blacklisting, as it penalizes against inclusion, in a candidate trigger, of tokens that induce signal perturbations "in the direction of" the putative target class of an attack. One version of our detector performs continuous optimization in token embedding space, while a companion trigger-inversion and detection method performs greedy accretion in discrete token space. Our methods give both strong detection performance and accurate inversion of ground-truth triggers on several LLM classification domains, and for several different LLM architectures.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对大型语言模型（LLM）在微调后可能被植入后门的安全问题，提出了一种新的后门检测与触发器反转框架CSO-LLM。现有后门检测方法多用于图像领域，难以直接迁移到LLM，原因有二：LLM的输入空间是离散的，且可能触发器令牌长度较大，导致搜索空间巨大；另外，检测时需要排除目标响应类别中的常见令牌，以避免误报，但全面构建黑名单在实践中极其困难。为此，作者提出了类子空间正交化（CSO）范式，这是一种即插即用的后门检测增强方法。CSO通过将模型对触发器的响应映射到与目标类方向正交的子空间，实现两个关键功能：1）提升基检测器的灵敏度和特异性；2）隐式地实现黑名单效果，即惩罚那些使扰动信号朝目标类方向偏移的候选触发器令牌。文章设计了两种实现：一种在令牌嵌入空间进行连续优化，另一种在离散令牌空间进行贪婪增量搜索。在多个LLM分类任务和不同架构上的实验表明，CSO-LLM能够有效检测后门并准确反转真实触发器，优于现有基线方法。该工作为LLM后门防御提供了新的技术路径。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: LLM在网络安全、内容审核等敏感场景应用广泛，后门攻击可导致严重误判。CSO-LLM首次将类子空间正交化引入LLM后门检测，解决了离散输入空间和隐式黑名单难题，提升了检测准确率和可解释性。

items.title: The Decomposition Is the Fingerprint: Per-Component Identity for Agent Skills
items.summary: AI agents increasingly acquire and execute skills at runtime: bundles of prompt instructions, executable code, and tool declarations fetched from marketplaces and other agents. Governing them needs a stable notion of skill identity, yet cryptographic hashing is engineered to destroy the very similarity we need, as a one-character edit scrambles the digest. We present a compact, locality-sensitive fingerprint that embeds each component of a skill and projects it to bits with a multi-bank SimHash, giving a fixed 120-byte signature compared in constant time by Hamming distance. Our central claim is that keeping the fingerprint as a per-component triple (prompt, code, tools), rather than a single score, is what makes it useful: the triple recovers skill-family identity through paraphrase, renaming, refactoring, and controlled code translation when another component remains shared, while independent multilingual reimplementation is not recovered; it also localizes which component carries the reuse. We claim lineage, not behavioral equivalence: identity supplies the structural axis of a registry and leaves safety to behavioral verification. The fingerprint reaches an area under the ROC curve (AUC) of 0.974 (95% CI [0.956, 0.994]) over 4,950 pairwise comparisons while using 77x fewer bits than the embedding it approximates, with ranking preserved in expectation and finite-bit concentration; the per-component split turns one number into relationship classification, families, novelty, and a portable "SkillBOM" for a skill registry. On a 906-skill injection benchmark the fingerprint recognizes injected skills as tampered copies of a known base and localizes the change, but recognition is not trust: it remains, by design, an identity signal complementary to behavioral verification rather than a safety verdict.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对AI agent在运行时动态获取技能（prompt指令、可执行代码、工具声明等组合）的身份识别问题展开研究。由于技能可能来自市场或其他agent，需要一种稳定的身份标识来管理技能来源和变更追踪。传统的加密哈希对微小改动敏感（如单字符编辑会完全改变摘要），无法满足相似性需求。为此，作者提出了一种紧凑的、局部敏感的数字指纹方法：首先将技能分解为prompt、code、tools三个独立组件，分别通过多bank SimHash投影到比特位，生成固定120字节的签名，并通过汉明距离进行常数时间比较。核心创新在于保持每个组件的独立指纹（而非合并为一个分数），使得指纹能够通过组件的共同部分恢复技能家族身份（如经过释义、重命名、重构、受控代码翻译等操作后，只要某个组件共享即可识别），同时独立的多语言重写不会被识别。该方法可用于技能注册表中的谱系追踪，而非行为等价性判定。实验在4,950个成对比较上达到AUC 0.974（95% CI [0.956, 0.994]），且使用的比特数比其近似的嵌入向量少77倍，排序期望保持且有限比特集中。在906个技能注入基准测试中，指纹能识别出注入技能是已知基础的篡改副本并定位变化，但作者强调该指纹仅作为行为验证的补充身份信号，而非安全判决。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 随着AI agent市场兴起，技能安全和溯源成为关键。该指纹提供了轻量级的技能身份和谱系识别方法，有助于检测技能篡改、克隆和供应链风险，是Agent安全治理的基础工具。

items.title: Securing the AI Agent: A Unified Framework for Multi-Layer Agent Red Teaming
items.summary: The fast growth of open-source AI infrastructure, from model serving engines and agent platforms to the Model Context Protocol (MCP) ecosystem and the language models themselves, has outpaced the security tooling available to defend it. We present AI-Infra-Guard, an open-source framework that organizes AI red teaming around a single observation: the attack surface of an AI agent is stratified across layers (infrastructure, protocol/tool, agent behavior, and model), and no single detection paradigm fits all of them. The framework therefore matches a paradigm to each layer, from deterministic rule matching over 75+ AI components and 1{,}400+ vulnerability rules, through LLM-driven agentic auditing of MCP servers and agent-skill packages and multi-turn black-box agent red teaming, to a jailbreak harness with 26+ attack operators over sixteen datasets. To our knowledge it is the only open-source framework to span all of these, including supply-chain auditing of the agent skills that increasingly extend AI agents. We release AI-Infra-Guard as open source so that \emph{layer-paradigm matching} can serve as a practical foundation for agent security and a shared base for the community to build on.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 随着开源AI基础设施（包括模型服务引擎、智能体平台、模型上下文协议（MCP）生态系统以及语言模型本身）的快速发展，其安全防护工具的发展已明显滞后。本文提出了一个名为AI-Infra-Guard的开源框架，旨在系统化组织AI红队测试。该框架基于一个核心观察：AI智能体的攻击面是分层分布的，包括基础设施层、协议/工具层、智能体行为层和模型层，没有任何单一的检测范式能够覆盖所有层次。因此，框架将不同的检测范式与各层相匹配：对于基础设施层，采用确定性规则匹配，覆盖超过75个AI组件和1400余条漏洞规则；对于协议/工具层，利用LLM驱动的自动化审计来检查MCP服务器和智能体技能包；对于智能体行为层，进行多轮黑盒红队测试；对于模型层，使用包含26种以上攻击算子和16个数据集的自适应越狱测试套件。据作者所知，这是唯一一个覆盖所有这些方面的开源框架，包括对日益扩展的智能体技能进行供应链审计。作者将AI-Infra-Guard开源，期望其“层-范式匹配”方法能成为智能体安全的基础实践和社区共建的共享底座。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该框架填补了AI智能体安全工具缺失的空白，首次提出分层范式匹配的实用方法论，为蓝队应对多层面攻击提供了系统化开源方案，值得安全从业者关注。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响AI智能体供应链安全审计、红队测试标准化，可迁移至企业内部AI应用安全评估和第三方AI组件风险检测等场景。

items.title: Probing Memorization of Tabular In-Context Learning
items.summary: Large tabular models (LTMs), i.e., tabular foundation models leveraging in-context learning (ICL), achieve state-of-the-art performance on tabular tasks. While LLMs are known to unintentionally memorize training data, the memorization dynamics of LTMs remain largely unexplored. We investigate the potential for parametric memorization in tabular ICL. We introduce ICLMEM, a probing framework designed to separate context-based predictions from parametric memorization. Our zero-information multiple-choice context strips away valid contextual patterns to force the model to fall back on its parametric memory. Our controlled fine-tuning setup establishes membership ground truth and accounts for common pitfalls, e.g., distribution shift, feature contamination, base-rate fallacy, and the pre-trained base model acts as reference to calibrate for sample difficulty. Our controlled evaluation on a leading real-world-trained LTM detects moderate memorization signals in 8 out of 10 tasks ($\text{AUC}$ up to $0.67$ and TPR at $1\%$ FPR $>0.1$). Notably, memorization signals are strongest for low-cardinality and binary tasks. However, they largely vanish under realistic training conditions. Our findings show LTM memorization signals under specific circumstances (single-task fine-tuning with fixed samples across many epochs and small query size). To protect sensitive data, appropriate measures must be taken, which we discuss.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文首次系统性地研究了大型表格模型（LTM）在上下文学习（ICL）中的参数记忆化问题。尽管大型语言模型（LLM）已被证明会无意中记忆训练数据，但LTM的记忆化动态尚不明确。作者提出了一种名为ICLMEM的探测框架，旨在将基于上下文的预测与参数记忆化分离开来。该框架通过构建零信息多选上下文，去除有效的上下文模式，迫使模型回退到参数记忆。同时，采用受控微调设置建立成员资格事实，并考虑了分布偏移、特征污染、基础率谬误等常见陷阱，以预训练基础模型作为参考来校准样本难度。作者在领先的真实世界训练LTM上进行了受控评估，在10个任务中的8个检测到了中等记忆化信号（AUC最高达0.67，在1%假阳性率下真正例率>0.1）。值得注意的是，低基数任务和二值任务的记忆化信号最强。然而，在更现实的训练条件下（如不进行单任务微调、使用多样化样本等），这些信号基本消失。研究发现表明，LTM的记忆化仅在特定情况下出现：单任务微调、固定样本的多轮次训练以及小的查询集。论文最后讨论了为保护敏感数据应采取的措施，例如限制微调轮次、增加训练数据多样性等。该工作为理解LTM的隐私风险提供了重要基础。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 安全从业者需要关注表格模型在上下文学习中的记忆化风险，这可能导致训练数据中的敏感信息（如医疗或金融记录）被意外泄露，尤其是在单任务微调场景中。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响涉及任何使用大型表格模型的场景，特别是对低基数或二值特征（如性别、疾病标识）的预测任务；结论可迁移至其他基于Transformer的表格模型。

对模型输出进行隐私审计，尤其在处理敏感数据时

items.title: Probe Choice Changes Canary-Memorization Verdicts: Three Post-Hoc Disagreement Case Studies in a Text-Dominant LoRA-Tuned Autoregressive Testbed
items.summary: We audit a fixed prefix-window mean-NLL memorization probe (K=20) on a Qwen2.5-VL-7B canary testbed and report three post-hoc cases where it disagrees with full-span secret NLL or greedy exact-recall. C3 (false negative, window truncation): damage lands on hex tokens outside K=20; the probe stays flat while hit@1 drops. C4 (false positive, non-secret drift): the probe moves, but approximately 99% sits on non-secret preamble; the secret span and hit@1 are unchanged. C5 (ambiguous in-window drop): the probe falls on an undertrained baseline while full-span hex is positive and hit@1=0. Recommendation: report (i) full-span secret NLL, (ii) a span-localised decomposition, (iii) behavioural exact-recall at k>=4, and (iv) decoy probes before asserting secret-specificity. Evidence is on controlled canaries in one backbone; magnitudes are testbed-specific.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文以Qwen2.5-VL-7B模型为骨干，通过LoRA微调构建了一个以文本为主的canary测试平台，审计了一种固定前缀窗口（K=20）的平均负对数似然（mean-NLL）记忆探测器的可靠性。研究发现了三种后验不一致案例：C3假阴性案例中，由于窗口截断，对关键十六进制token的损害落在K=20之外，导致探测器平坦不变而精确召回率（hit@1）下降；C4假阳性案例中，探测器数值移动，但约99%的贡献来自非秘文的序言部分，秘文区间及hit@1保持不变；C5模糊案例中，探测器在欠训练的基线上下降，而全跨度十六进制NLL为正且hit@1为0。作者指出，单一前缀窗口探测器可能误导对模型记忆程度的判断，并建议同时报告（i）全跨度秘文NLL、（ii）跨度局部化分解、（iii）至少k>=4的行为精确召回率，以及（iv）在断言秘文特异性之前使用诱饵探测器。该研究强调了探测选择对LLM隐私审计结论的关键影响。

items.title: An Empirical Study of Security Calibration in Large Language Models for Code
items.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are rapidly transforming software development, yet their use in security-critical contexts raises a key question: do models know when their generated code is insecure? This property, known as calibration, measures whether a model's confidence aligns with the true correctness of its outputs. We present the first large-scale empirical study of security calibration in LLM-generated code. We evaluate GPT-4o-mini, Gemini-2.0-Flash, and Qwen3-Coder-Next across multiple temperature settings on two complementary benchmarks: self-contained security tasks and multi-language repository-level contexts. Our results suggest that overconfidence is prevalent across the evaluated LLMs. Functional calibration is consistently worse than security calibration, suggesting that models estimate security outcomes more reliably than functional correctness, potentially because functional correctness depends on complex execution behavior. We also examine whether calibration-guided automated repair can help remediate vulnerabilities in LLM-generated code, finding only limited improvements while frequently introducing functional regressions. Moreover, we study different mitigation strategies for reducing False Trust, where models assign high confidence to vulnerable code. The results show that although architectural gating improves calibration on controlled benchmarks, calibration deteriorates in realistic repository-level settings, increasing the risk of high-confidence vulnerable outputs.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文对大型语言模型（LLM）在代码生成中的安全校准问题进行了首次大规模实证研究。校准是指模型对其输出正确性的置信度与实际正确性之间的对齐程度。研究评估了 GPT-4o-mini、Gemini-2.0-Flash 和 Qwen3-Coder-Next 三个模型，在多个温度设置下，使用两个互补基准：自包含安全任务和多语言仓库级上下文。主要发现包括：LLM 普遍存在过度自信现象；功能校准（functional calibration）始终比安全校准（security calibration）更差，表明模型对安全结果的估计相对更可靠，可能是因为功能正确性依赖于复杂的执行行为；基于校准的自动化修复仅能有限地改善漏洞，且经常引入功能回归。此外，研究探讨了减少“虚假信任”（即模型对脆弱代码赋予高置信度）的缓解策略，结果表明架构门控（architectural gating）在可控基准上改善校准，但在现实的仓库级设置中校准反而恶化，增加了高置信度脆弱输出的风险。该研究为 LLM 代码生成的安全可靠性提供了重要见解。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: LLM 越来越广泛地用于代码生成，但模型对其输出安全性的置信度可能不可靠，导致安全漏洞被忽视。该研究揭示了过度自信问题，提醒安全从业者不能盲目信任 LLM 生成的代码。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有使用 LLM 辅助开发的场景，尤其是安全关键系统；研究结果可迁移到其他 LLM 安全可信度评估。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进，谨慎使用 LLM 生成的代码，建议结合静态分析和人工审查。

items.title: Secure-CHG: A Comprehensive Framework for Robust and Fair Federated Learning via Hybrid Defense and Contribution-Aware Trust
items.summary: Federated Learning (FL) is highly susceptible to stealthy backdoor attacks, which aim to force a model into predicting an attacker-chosen target class for inputs containing a specific trigger. However, existing statistical defenses primarily focus on the early stages of model convergence. In this paper, we identify a fundamental vulnerability termed ``Late-stage Failure.'' We demonstrate that as the global model converges, decaying gradient norms render malicious and benign updates morphologically indistinguishable. This vanishing statistical variance effectively blinds traditional defenses, enabling adaptive adversaries to remain dormant and subsequently hijack the training process. To overcome these constraints, we propose Secure-CHG, a hybrid framework that pivots the defense paradigm from superficial morphological detection toward intrinsic semantic contribution verification. Secure-CHG employs an adaptive defense pipeline: a cascaded statistical filter stabilizes optimization during the early oscillatory phase, while a novel CHG-Shapley mechanism takes over during late-stage convergence. By leveraging sample hardness (i.e., local training loss) to project updates into a composite Hardness-Gradient space, it effectively amplifies adversarial semantic traces, enabling the isolation of stealthy attackers even as gradient norms vanish. Furthermore, we derive a closed-form solution for CHG-Shapley, facilitating low-complexity, retraining-free node valuation and trust-modulated aggregation. Extensive evaluations on CIFAR-10, MedMNIST, and NEU-SDDB demonstrate that Secure-CHG effectively mitigates Late-stage Failure. Specifically, it significantly suppresses advanced backdoor attacks, reducing their attack success rate by 2.3$\times$ and 2.0$\times$ relative to the mainstream Krum and Trimmed Mean baselines, respectively.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文聚焦于联邦学习中的后门攻击防御问题。作者首先发现现有统计防御方法存在一个根本性漏洞——“晚期失败”（Late-stage Failure）：随着全局模型收敛，梯度范数逐渐减小，导致恶意更新与良性更新在形态上难以区分，传统基于统计特征的防御方法失效。为克服这一局限，论文提出Secure-CHG混合防御框架，将防御范式从表面的形态检测转向内在的语义贡献验证。框架包含自适应防御流水线：在早期振荡阶段，级联统计滤波器稳定优化过程；在晚期收敛阶段，引入创新的CHG-Shapley机制，利用样本难度（即局部训练损失）将更新投影到复合硬度-梯度空间，有效放大对抗性语义痕迹，即使在梯度范数消失时也能隔离隐蔽攻击者。此外，论文推导出CHG-Shapley的闭式解，实现了低复杂度、无需重训练的节点估值和信任调节聚合。在CIFAR-10、MedMNIST和NEU-SDDB数据集上的大量实验表明，Secure-CHG能有效缓解晚期失败问题：相比主流Krum和Trimmed Mean基线，显著抑制高级后门攻击，攻击成功率分别降低2.3倍和2.0倍。该研究为联邦学习安全提供了新视角，适合联邦学习研究人员、安全工程师及对机器学习鲁棒性感兴趣的读者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了联邦学习防御中晚期收敛阶段的盲区，提出的CHG-Shapley机制从语义层面检测隐蔽后门，弥补了现有统计方法的不足。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 提升联邦学习系统对高级后门攻击的鲁棒性，可应用于医疗、工业等敏感数据联合训练场景。

items.title: Certified Speculative Execution for Untrusted AI Agents
items.summary: Hard-constrained sequential decision systems have no certified way to spend the test-time compute of modern AI: executing the multi-step drafts of a learned policy or a frozen LLM forfeits the feasibility guarantee a trusted solver provides, while invoking the solver at every step forfeits the speed the AI offers. Certificate-Gated Prefix Acceptance (CGPA) closes this gap with a certified speculative-execution contract for untrusted AI agents: a trusted verifier rejects constraint-violating transitions exactly, a conformally calibrated value boundary gates the longest low-cost prefix within a per-segment regret budget, and the rest defers to the solver, so safety, regret, and speed decouple by construction. The contract drives every untrusted proposal source - adversarial drafters and six heterogeneous frozen LLMs (including a 12B model that violates constraints in 98% of direct rollouts) - to zero applied violations; a certificate-aware learned boundary, conformally calibrated, drives mean regret three orders of magnitude below unguarded acceptance, to within sampling noise of the stepwise oracle (95% CI spanning zero), and under calendar shift a learned proposal source overtakes it on 15 of 18 held-out days. On a deployment-scale unit-commitment instance it turns a frozen 8B LLM into a 2.96x per-episode wall-clock speedup at 2.1% regret, outpacing the domain heuristic (1.79x) and a safe receding-horizon baseline (1.07x): the more capable the untrusted source, the faster the certified system, at guarantees that never change.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对受限顺序决策系统中AI智能体执行时的安全与效率矛盾问题，提出了一种名为“证书门控前缀接受”（CGPA）的认证推测执行框架。传统方法中，使用信任求解器（如优化器）保证可行性会牺牲AI的快速性，而直接让AI（如学习策略或冻结LLM）执行多步草稿则可能违反硬约束。CGPA通过一个信任的验证器精确拒绝违反约束的转换，并利用保形校准的值边界在每段遗憾预算内接受最长低代价前缀，将安全、遗憾和速度解耦。实验表明，CGPA能驱使任意不信任的提议源（包括对抗性草稿者和六个异构冻结LLM，其中12B模型直接 rollout 时98%违反约束）实现零应用违规；一个证书感知的学习边界，经保形校准，将平均遗憾降至无保护接受的三个数量级以下，接近逐步oracle（95%置信区间包含零）。在日历偏移下，学习提议源在18天中有15天优于基线。在部署规模机组组合实例中，CGPA将冻结8B LLM转化为每回合2.96倍的墙钟加速，遗憾仅为2.1%，远超领域启发式（1.79倍）和安全滚动时域基线（1.07倍）。结论是：不信任源能力越强，认证系统越快，且保证不变。本文适合对AI安全、可信执行、LLM部署和约束优化感兴趣的研究者和工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 提出了首个将LLM等不信任AI智能体与安全约束结合的认证执行框架，在保证安全的前提下大幅提升效率，为解决AI部署中的安全-效率权衡提供了新思路。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到任何需要安全约束的AI决策系统，如自动驾驶、机器人控制、电力调度等，特别是在使用大型语言模型作为快速提议器时。

items.title: Curvature-Guided Module Localization for Low-Rank Detoxification of Backdoored Large Language Models
items.summary: Backdoor attacks pose a serious threat to large language models (LLMs) by causing otherwise benign systems to produce attacker-specified malicious behavior when a hidden trigger is present. In this work, we study post hoc detoxification of backdoored LLMs in a practical setting where the defender has access to the poisoned model but does not wish to retrain the full network from scratch. We propose a mechanistically guided weight-space repair framework that first localizes modules involved in propagating trigger-induced behavior using activation patching and Fisher/K-FAC curvature analysis, and then applies targeted low-rank repair to only the most influential modules. We evaluate the method on poisoned variants of \texttt{Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct} with triggers inserted at the beginning, middle, and end of otherwise benign prompts. Results show that the proposed approach substantially suppresses trigger-conditioned malicious responses while preserving benign model behavior. These findings suggest that backdoor removal in LLMs can be formulated as a localized structural repair problem rather than only a broad behavioral alignment problem.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究大语言模型（LLM）面临的后门攻击威胁，即攻击者在模型中植入隐蔽触发器，使模型在遇到特定输入时产生恶意行为。作者聚焦于实际防御场景：防御者拥有被污染的模型，但不想从头重新训练。他们提出一种机制引导的权重空间修复框架，首先利用激活修补（activation patching）和Fisher/K-FAC曲率分析定位与触发器行为传播相关的模块，然后仅对最关键的模块进行针对性低秩修复。实验在Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct模型上评估，将触发器植入良性提示的开头、中间或结尾。结果显示，该方法能显著抑制触发器引发的恶意响应，同时保持良性的模型行为。该工作表明LLM的后门移除可以形式化为局部结构性修复问题，而非仅依赖广泛的行为对齐。适合关注LLM安全、后门防御的研究者和从业者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 提出了一种可解释、高效的LLM后门修复方法，避免全模型重训，为实际部署中的深度防御提供了新思路。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于其他Transformer架构模型的后门检测与修复，迁移至多模态、代码生成等场景。

items.title: AI-Generated PowerShell Malware: An Experimental Framework and Dataset
items.summary: Generative AI has emerged as a significant cybersecurity threat, with several recent attack campaigns leveraging LLMs to generate code for malicious purposes via scripting languages such as PowerShell. Consequently, for cybersecurity analysts, it is imperative to investigate the offensive capabilities of AI code generators. In this paper, we propose an experimental framework to assess LLM-generated PowerShell malware, which comprises a novel sandbox approach for dynamic analysis of AI-generated malware. Furthermore, we present a novel, manually curated dataset of real-world PowerShell malware, annotated in natural language to assist the training and evaluation of LLMs. Finally, this study evaluates permissive, open-weight LLMs adapted to PowerShell malware generation. Our results reveal a high degree of similarity between real malware and LLM-generated ones in terms of triggered OS malicious events, with a median Jaccard index of 84.5% and 48.4% of instances achieving complete overlap.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对生成式AI（尤其是大型语言模型LLM）被用于生成恶意代码的安全威胁，提出了一个实验框架来评估LLM生成的PowerShell恶意软件。该框架包含一种新颖的沙箱方法，用于对AI生成的恶意软件进行动态分析。此外，作者构建并公开了一个手动标注的真实世界PowerShell恶意软件数据集，该数据集包含自然语言注释，可辅助LLM的训练与评估。研究评估了多个允许商用、开放权重的LLM在PowerShell恶意软件生成任务上的表现。结果显示，LLM生成的恶意软件与真实恶意软件在触发的操作系统恶意事件方面高度相似，中位Jaccard指数达到84.5%，且48.4%的实例实现了事件完全重叠。该工作揭示了AI辅助恶意软件生成的风险，并为防御方提供了检测和防范的基准。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究证实了LLM可生成与真实恶意软件行为高度相似的PowerShell代码，威胁真实系统，安全团队需重新评估AI辅助攻击的风险并加强相关检测。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响包括：提升AI生成恶意软件的检测难度，可能推动攻击自动化；防御方可利用其数据集和框架改进动态分析沙箱或训练检测模型。

items.title: Off the Rails: Hijacking the Scoring Head in Generative End-to-End Driving Planners with Safety-Violating Adversarial Perturbations
items.summary: Generative models have recently seen rapid adoption in End-to-End (E2E) autonomous driving (AD), with diffusion-based denoising and vocabulary-based retrieval becoming the dominant trajectory-decoding paradigms. Despite their architectural diversity, current generative AD planners share a common inference pattern: a fixed set of candidate trajectories (anchors, vocabulary entries, or proposal queries) is scored by one or more learned heads conditioned on the Bird's-Eye-View (BEV) features, and the highest-scored candidate is returned as the final trajectory. Under this design, the scoring head is the only barrier between perception and the motion command, and its decision margins between competing candidates are often small. We introduce \textsc{Derail}, an adversarial framework that exploits this scoring-head attack surface. Evaluated on various generative planners, \textsc{Derail} flips the trajectory selection from a safe to an unsafe candidate, with score drops of $39$--$80\%$ and collision rates of up to $50\%$, consistently outperforming generic loss-maximization and feature-divergence attacks. Our analysis suggests that safety-violating objectives govern attack effectiveness against generative AD planners, and that the scoring-head inference pattern itself is a recurring attack surface worth explicit defensive consideration.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究了生成式端到端自动驾驶规划器中的安全漏洞。当前主流的生成式规划器（如基于扩散去噪或词汇检索的）共享一个共同推理模式：固定候选轨迹集合（锚点、词汇条目或提议查询）由学习到的评分头部根据鸟瞰视图特征进行打分，最高分轨迹作为最终输出。评分头部成为感知与运动指令之间的唯一屏障，且竞争候选之间的决策边界往往很小。作者提出名为Derail的对抗框架，利用这一攻击面。在多种生成式规划器上的实验表明，Derail能够将轨迹选择从安全候选翻转为危险候选，分数下降39%–80%，碰撞率高达50%，性能持续优于通用损失最大化攻击和特征散度攻击。分析表明，违反安全的目标决定了攻击对生成式规划器的有效性，而评分头部的推理模式本身是一个值得明确防御考虑的反复出现的安全隐患。本文适合自动驾驶安全工程师、AI系统安全研究员以及端到端规划器开发者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 首次揭示了生成式端到端自动驾驶规划器中评分头部架构的系统性攻击面，且攻击效果显著（碰撞率高达50%），对部署安全性构成严重威胁。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接威胁所有采用类似推理模式的生成式自动驾驶规划器（包括基于扩散和词汇检索的方法），影响面覆盖当前多数前沿自动驾驶系统。

items.title: Revocable Learned State via Process Sidecars
items.summary: Language models are often adapted in stages: a public skill phase, a private memory phase, and a later safety phase that learns to refuse outputs tied to the remembered entities. Revoking the memory after the safety phase is not the same problem as subtracting the memory update: the later safety optimizer has transported the memory direction. We introduce process sidecars, a two-coefficient edit family $\hatθ(λ,γ)=θ_{\mathrm{AMS}}-λΔ_{\mathrm{M}}-γ\hat{R}_{\mathrm{S}\leftarrow\mathrm{M}}$, with $\hat{R}_{\mathrm{S}\leftarrow\mathrm{M}}=\hat{J}_{\mathrm{S},\varepsilon}(Δ_{\mathrm{M}})-Δ_{\mathrm{M}}$, where $\hat{J}_{\mathrm{S},\varepsilon}$ is a centered secant through the realized future AdamW safety-training process. The implementation uses $\varepsilon=1$ at the natural memory-edit scale; it reuses $θ_{\mathrm{AMS}}$ as the positive endpoint and computes one additional safety trace at $θ_{\mathrm{A}}-Δ_{\mathrm{M}}$. We prove two things. First, the exact sidecar, using the true transported direction $R_{\mathrm{S}\leftarrow\mathrm{M}}$ rather than the secant estimate, at $(λ,γ)=(1,1)$ recovers the counterfactual safety-only oracle $θ_{\mathrm{AS}}$ up to second order; the proof treats AdamW as an augmented-state map over parameters, first moments, and second moments. Second, this process information is necessary: whenever future safety training bends the memory direction, every scalar task-arithmetic edit leaves first-order counterfactual error, while the process-sidecar edit is second-order accurate. Across three models, the validation-selected 2D edit improves held-out refusal closure over naive task arithmetic in all trials, and over the $γ=λ$ process-JVP subfamily, the diagonal slice of the cached 2D grid, in all paired trials.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对语言模型安全微调后难以完全撤销已学习记忆的问题，提出了一种名为“process sidecars”的两系数编辑方法。研究背景是：语言模型通常经历公开技能阶段、私有记忆阶段和后续安全阶段，但安全优化器会改变记忆方向，导致简单减法无法有效撤销记忆。核心方法是通过构建一个两系数的编辑家族 $\hat{\theta}(\lambda,\gamma)=\theta_{\mathrm{AMS}}-\lambda\Delta_{\mathrm{M}}-\gamma\hat{R}_{\mathrm{S}\leftarrow\mathrm{M}}$，其中 $\hat{R}_{\mathrm{S}\leftarrow\mathrm{M}}=\hat{J}_{\mathrm{S},\varepsilon}(\Delta_{\mathrm{M}})-\Delta_{\mathrm{M}}$ 利用实际AdamW安全训练过程的中心割线估计记忆方向的变化。论文通过理论证明表明，精确的sidecar（使用真实传输方向）在特定系数下能以二阶精度恢复反事实的安全模型。此外，论文证明当未来安全训练弯曲记忆方向时，任何标量任务算术编辑都会留下线性误差，而process sidecar编辑具有二阶精度。实验在三个模型上进行，验证了所选2D编辑在所有试验中均优于朴素任务算术，且在配对试验中优于 $\gamma=\lambda$ 子族。主要贡献：提出了一种可撤销记忆的方法，理论严谨，实验有效，为模型安全更新提供了新思路。适合关注模型安全、模型编辑和持续学习的AI安全研究人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作直接回应了语言模型安全微调后无法干净撤销记忆的痛点，为AI安全运维提供了更精细的记忆撤销手段，有助于防止模型在部署后持续输出敏感信息。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于需要动态调整模型记忆的安全场景，如法规数据遗忘、用户隐私删除、模型持续安全更新等。对AI监管和合规领域有潜在价值。

items.title: Security--Fidelity Tradeoffs: The Hidden Cost of Prompt Injection Defense
items.summary: We identify a security-fidelity tradeoff in defending LLMs against indirect prompt injection: defenses resist injected instructions largely by suppressing untrusted text, which corrupts tasks that must preserve it, such as translation and document editing. Attack-success metrics cannot see this, because a model that ignores an injection and one that faithfully processes it as data score identically. We introduce SecFid, a benchmark built so that executing an injection, processing it as data, and ignoring it produce distinguishable outputs. This makes fidelity measurable and exposes a frontier: across 1,168 examples and 48 configurations, no model or defense achieves both objectives. The highest-fidelity model reaches 96.5% fidelity at 47.8% security, while the most secure defenses invert this, at 99.3% security but only 71.0%-73.9% fidelity. Even defenses with identical security differ in how they earn it: some repair hijacks into faithful processing, others simply suppress benign content. A decision-theoretic analysis shows why no fixed choice can be right everywhere: the correct behavior is not a property of the defense but of the deployment, set by its relative cost of a hijack versus a dropped span. Security alone therefore measures only half of robustness, and reporting it without fidelity hides the price at which it was bought.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文揭示了防御LLM免受间接提示注入攻击时存在安全性与保真度之间的根本性权衡。传统攻击成功指标无法区分两种截然不同的行为：模型忽略注入指令（安全但可能丢失信息）与模型将注入内容作为正常数据处理（保真度高但易受攻击）。为此，作者构建了SecFid基准测试，通过设计输出可区分的任务（如翻译、文档编辑），使得执行注入、作为数据处理和忽略注入产生不同结果，从而可量化保真度。实验涵盖1168个样本和48种配置，结果表明没有模型或防御能同时实现高安全和高保真：最高保真度的模型达到96.5%保真度但仅47.8%安全，而最安全的防御将安全提升至99.3%但保真度降至71.0%-73.9%。进一步分析发现，即使安全指标相同的防御，其实现方式也不同：有的通过修复劫持让模型正确处理注入，有的则直接抑制良性内容。决策理论分析表明，不存在普适的最优选择，正确的行为取决于部署场景中劫持成本与丢弃片段的相对代价。因此，仅关注安全指标只能衡量鲁棒性的一半，忽略保真度会掩盖防御的真实代价。该研究适合LLM安全研究人员、AI系统防御者及部署LLM应用的技术团队阅读，以理解安全评估中保真度的重要性，并指导在实际场景中权衡两者。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了LLM防御中安全与保真度的矛盾，提醒安全团队不能只看安全指标，需结合任务保真度评估整体效果。决策理论分析为实际部署选择防御策略提供了理论依据。

items.title: Understanding and Evaluating Claw-like Agent Security Through a Computer-Systems Lens
items.summary: Claw-like AI agents (e.g., OpenClaw) are always-on processes with persistent access to credentials, files, tools, and external services. They take on system-level responsibilities -- installing packages, maintaining state, scheduling subtasks, and mediating I/O -- making security failures far more severe than in other agents. Yet existing benchmarks focus on model responses and tool calls, leaving cross-component failure modes largely unmeasured. We adopt a computer-system analogy: treating a Claw-like agent as an agentic computer system whose gateway runtime plays an OS-like mediation role, whose Skills resemble user-installed applications, and whose Plugins resemble loadable extensions with runtime privileges. Each component has a classical counterpart whose protection mechanisms -- refined over decades of cybersecurity research -- are absent on the agent side. From this perspective, we develop SafeClawArena, a benchmark of 406 adversarial tasks across four attack surfaces (Skill Supply-Chain Integrity, Persistent State Exploitation, Cross-Boundary Data Flow, and Indirect Prompt Injection), executed in containerized replicas of real agent platforms with canary-marked credentials and evaluated via automated taint tracking across nine output channels. We evaluate three platforms (OpenClaw, NemoClaw, SeClaw) and five frontier LLMs. The highest attack success rate reaches 70%; malicious Plugins succeed in 100% of cases regardless of the LLM. SeClaw cuts GPT-5.4's attack success rate from 70% to 22%, partly through utility-security tradeoffs rather than active defenses, while Claude-Opus-4.6 already sits near a 22% floor on every platform. These results expose the inadequacy of current defenses and suggest directions for future hardening. Code and data: https://github.com/sunblaze-ucb/SafeClawArena.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对“类Claw”人工智能代理（如OpenClaw）的安全问题进行了系统研究。类Claw代理是一种常驻进程，具有对凭证、文件、工具和外部服务的持久访问权限，承担系统级任务（如安装包、维护状态、调度子任务、管理I/O），其安全故障后果比其他代理严重得多。然而，现有基准测试仅关注模型响应和工具调用，缺乏对跨组件故障模式的评估。作者采用计算机系统类比：将类Claw代理视为一个代理计算机系统，其网关运行时扮演类似操作系统的中介角色，技能模块类似于用户安装的应用程序，插件类似于具有运行时权限的可加载扩展。每个组件在经典系统中都有相应的保护机制（如OS隔离、文件权限等），但代理侧缺失这些机制。基于此视角，作者开发了SafeClawArena基准测试，包含406个对抗性任务，覆盖四个攻击面：技能供应链完整性、持久状态利用、跨边界数据流和间接提示注入。实验在容器化复现的真实代理平台上进行，使用金丝雀标记的凭证，并通过自动污点跟踪评估九个输出通道。评估了三个平台（OpenClaw、NemoClaw、SeClaw）和五个前沿大语言模型。结果显示，最高攻击成功率达到70%；恶意插件无论使用何种LLM，成功率均为100%。SeClaw通过效用-安全权衡而非主动防御，将GPT-5.4的攻击成功率从70%降至22%，而Claude-Opus-4.6在每个平台上均已接近22%的下限。这些结果暴露了当前防御的不足，并提出了未来加固的方向。代码和数据集已开源。适合AI安全研究人员、AI代理开发者和安全工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究首次从计算机系统安全视角系统性评估类Claw代理的安全性，揭示了现有防御的严重不足，为构建更安全的AI代理系统提供了关键基准和方向。

items.title: Authentication in Quantum Networks
items.summary: In this review, we survey the cryptographic task of authentication from the perspective of quantum communication. We review three main flavours of authentication that are often conflated in the literature: authentication of classical messages, authentication of quantum messages, and entity authentication, also covering recent hardware-assisted approaches. We compare representative protocols for each functionality in terms of their security assumptions, set-up requirements, composability, and scalability in large or dynamic networks, and use these criteria to identify and recommend suitable candidates. Finally, applications are surveyed: we provide a detailed case study of authentication and quantum key distribution (QKD), then extend the discussion to protocols beyond QKD, where the role of authentication is more complex. Our take-home message is that an authentication requirement is not an intrinsic limitation of quantum networks: as with all secure communication, each protocol relies on a particular authentication resource, and the security claim of that protocol is meaningful only once the authentication resource and its deployment assumptions are made explicit. At the same time, the existing classical and quantum literature already offers a range of quantum-secure authentication schemes, which can support different applications when carefully matched to the required functionality, assumptions, and security guarantees.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文是一篇关于量子网络中认证问题的综述。量子网络依赖于量子密钥分发（QKD）等协议，而认证是确保通信安全的基础。然而，文献中常混淆三种不同类型的认证：经典消息认证、量子消息认证和实体认证。此外，还有硬件辅助认证等新方法。论文系统梳理了这三类认证的代表性协议，从安全假设、设置需求、可组合性和在大规模/动态网络中的可扩展性等维度进行了比较，并据此推荐了合适的候选方案。论文还深入分析了认证与QKD结合的实际案例，并扩展到QKD以外的协议，在这些协议中认证的角色更为复杂。核心结论是：认证需求并不是量子网络的内在限制；每个协议依赖于特定的认证资源，其安全声明只有在明确认证资源和部署假设时才有意义。同时，现有的经典和量子文献已经提供了多种能够抵御量子攻击的认证方案，只要根据所需功能、假设和安全保证仔细匹配，就能支持不同的应用场景。该综述适合量子通信、密码学和安全领域的研究人员和工程师阅读，有助于厘清认证在量子网络中的角色和选择合适方案。

items.title: MESA: Prioritizing Vulnerable Communication Channels for Securing Multi-Agent Systems
items.summary: Multi-agent systems (MAS) are increasingly used to automate complex, distributed workflows. However, their inter-agent communication channels introduce new attack surfaces that remain poorly understood and are difficult to defend against. In this paper, we address how defenders should prioritize limited security effort to protect vulnerable communication channels before attacks are observed. This is motivated by our observation that the channel-level attack impact is highly non-uniform: a single compromised edge can account for up to 75% of total attack success. We introduce Mesa, a label-free framework for proactively ranking which MAS edges are most security-critical -- that is, most likely to affect the system's decision if compromised. Mesa combines six graph-theoretic metrics and two dynamic probes (ablation and masking) without requiring attack traces. We evaluate Mesa against a dynamic misinformation attack pipeline across three diverse MAS scenarios, eight network topologies, and five open-source LLMs from Qwen, Llama, and Gemma families. Mesa rankings correlate strongly with empirical per-edge attack success rate, achieving mean Spearman $ρ=+0.60$ (peaking at $+0.73$). In resource-constrained defense deployment, monitoring the top 10% of Mesa-ranked edges intercepts about 3x the successful attacks as random allocation. We further test Mesa under varying attacker and defender models and LangGraph workflows and characterize its limits under adaptive attacks and high-redundancy graphs. Overall, our results show that edge-level risk in MAS is often concentrated and predictable, allowing proactive hardening of multi-agent infrastructures.

llm_summary.summary_zh:
本论文针对多智能体系统（MAS）中智能体间通信渠道的安全防护问题展开研究。随着MAS被广泛应用于自动化复杂分布式工作流，其内部通信渠道引入了新的攻击面，但现有理解不足且难以防御。作者观察到，信道级别的攻击影响高度不均匀：单一受损边可能占据总攻击成功率的75%。因此，本文旨在帮助防御者在观察到攻击之前，优先投入有限的安全资源保护最脆弱的通信渠道。

为此，作者提出了MESA（Multi-agent Edge Security Assessment）框架，这是一种无需标签的主动排序方法，能够识别MAS中哪些通信边（edge）最具安全关键性——即一旦被攻陷最可能影响系统决策。MESA结合了六种图论度量（如度中心性、介数中心性等）和两种动态探测方法（消融实验和掩码实验），无需依赖攻击轨迹。作者在三个不同的MAS场景、八种网络拓扑结构以及五个开源大语言模型（来自Qwen、Llama和Gemma系列）上，针对动态虚假信息攻击流程进行了评估。实验结果表明，MESA排序与经验性的每条边攻击成功率高度相关，平均斯皮尔曼相关系数ρ=+0.60，最高可达+0.73。在资源受限的防御部署中，监控MESA排序前10%的边能够拦截约3倍于随机分配的成功攻击。作者还测试了MESA在不同攻击者和防御者模型以及LangGraph工作流下的表现，并刻画了其在自适应攻击和高冗余图下的局限性。总体而言，研究证明MAS中的边级风险往往集中且可预测，从而可以实现对多智能体基础设施的主动加固。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 多智能体系统安全是新兴领域，现有研究多聚焦整体系统安全，忽略了单个通信渠道的优先级。本文首次提出无监督的边级风险评估方法，为防御者提供了可操作的攻击面优先级排序，具有实用价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于所有基于LLM的多智能体系统，特别是在资源受限场景下优化防御资源分配，可迁移至其他分布式系统中的关键链路识别。

items.title: Wireless Backdoor Attack and Defense for Semantic Communications over Multiple Access Channel
items.summary: Semantic communication (SemCom) aims to preserve semantic meaning and task-oriented information beyond conventional message recovery over wireless channels. The adoption of SemCom in shared-access wireless networks introduces new vulnerabilities for multi-user semantic inference. This paper considers a SemCom system for two transmitters communicating with a common receiver over a multiple access channel. Each transmitter maps source information into latent semantic representations, while the receiver jointly reconstructs and classifies the semantic information for both transmitters. A selective over-the-air backdoor (Trojan) attack is presented in which an adversary transmits a low-power trigger waveform over the air and injects it into the shared received signal during training. By transmitting the trigger again during testing, this stealthy, low-power attack selectively manipulates the semantic inference for one transmitter while minimally affecting the inference of the other transmitter. To mitigate this vulnerability, a trigger-aware defense mechanism is developed to preserve correct semantic labels under trigger-contaminated wireless observations. The results demonstrate both the vulnerability of shared-access SemCom systems to selective over-the-air backdoor attacks and the effectiveness of trigger-aware robust training for semantic protection.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究多址接入信道（MAC）下语义通信（SemCom）系统的无线后门攻击与防御问题。语义通信旨在超越传统比特级恢复，保留语义信息和任务导向信息，在共享接入无线网络中具有重要前景。然而，共享接入环境引入了新的安全漏洞，特别是针对多用户语义推理的后门攻击。论文假设一个SemCom系统，两个发射器通过MAC向一个公共接收器通信。每个发射器将源信息映射为潜在语义表示，接收器联合重建和分类两个发射器的语义信息。作者提出一种选择性无线后门（特洛伊）攻击：在训练阶段，攻击者发射低功率触发波形，将其注入共享接收信号；在测试阶段，再次发射相同的触发，即可选择性地操纵其中一个发射器的语义推理结果，而对另一个发射器影响极小。该攻击具有隐蔽性和低功耗特性，难以被传统检测方法发现。为抵御此类攻击，论文提出一种触发感知的防御机制，通过在训练过程中引入触发污染的观测样本，进行鲁棒训练，从而在存在触发时仍能保持正确的语义标签。实验结果表明，共享接入SemCom系统容易受到选择性无线后门攻击，而触发感知的鲁棒训练能有效保护语义推理的完整性。本工作揭示了语义通信在物理层安全方面的新挑战，并为设计更安全的无线AI系统提供了思路。适合无线安全、AI安全以及语义通信领域的研究者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 首次在语义通信的多址接入场景中揭示选择性无线后门攻击的威胁，并提出了可行的防御方法。对保障未来无线AI系统的安全性有重要启示。
